## WHAT MAKES US EPIC? At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development. ## QUALITY ASSURANCE ### **What We Do** The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers. ## SDET INTERN ### **What You'll Do** Epic Games Art Ops team is looking for a smart, creative Software Development Engineer in Test Intern. Art Ops is the team that builds the tools, pipelines, and Al workflows our artists use for game development and emerging tech every day. This role focuses on testing those internal tools and frameworks; you'll embed with our team of engineers and technical artists to help design and build everything from Cl pipelines, test plans, and integration tests for our web apps to checks that tell us how well our Al tools are performing. ### **In this role, you will** - Write test plans for new tools and features, then turn them into automated tests - Help design and build the test framework our team will use going forward, with our engineers reviewing your code - Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for our web apps and pipeline tools - Test how Al tools and workflows perform when new models are released, and help build ways to measure their performance - Support weekly release testing and turn repeated manual checks into automated tests - Investigate test failures, determine why a test broke, and share results with the team - Use Al-assisted tools to help run, write, and triage tests, and review what they produce ### **What we're looking for** - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field - Comfortable writing code in at least one modern OOP language such as Python, C++, or C#, through coursework or personal projects - Basic understanding of software testing, such as unit and integration testing - Familiarity with a version control system - Interest in Al for content and code generation - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to confidently collaborate with senior team members and take feedback on technical topics and features - Willingness to dive into new things and drive them forward - A personal project repository or demo portfolio is required - Some experience with test frameworks like Jest, Pytest, or Playwright, Cl systems like GitHub Actions, or Al evaluation tools like LangChain or DeepEval is desired - Exposure to art tools such as Unreal Engine, Maya, or Houdini, or interest in how artists work is highly desired *This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit [](https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/earlycareers). **Mob Entertainment**is a startup multimedia studio that is best known for our hit indie horror game "**Poppy Playtime"**. This franchise is one of the hottest new properties in gaming, and our team is naturally expanding as our ambition expands. **To give a taste of our brand's popularity, more than 200 billion YouTube views of Poppy Playtime related content have occurred since the game's launch 6 years ago.** Mob Entertainment is seeking a Junior Gameplay Programmer to join the team supporting development of one of our upcoming Unreal Engine projects. This role is designed for an engineer early in their career who is eager to grow their skills in gameplay programming while working alongside senior engineers and designers on real production systems. You'll work under the guidance of senior gameplay and systems engineers, implementing and iterating on gameplay features, fixing bugs, and supporting the team's day-to-day production needs. This is a hands-on learning role, ideal for someone who wants to build a strong foundation in Unreal Engine while contributing meaningfully to a shipping title. ## Responsibilities - Implement gameplay features and mechanics in Unreal Engine using both C++ and Blueprints, under the direction of senior engineers. - Assist in building and iterating on core gameplay systems (player interactions, triggers, pickups, simple AI behaviors, UI hookups, etc.). - Identify, reproduce, and fix bugs reported by QA, designers, or other team members, tracked through Jira. - Support senior engineers by prototyping mechanics, testing systems, and turning rough ideas into working in-engine examples. - Collaborate closely with designers to implement and tune gameplay behavior based on feedback and playtesting. - Write clean, readable code and follow the team's existing coding standards and conventions. - Participate in code reviews as both a reviewer and a recipient of feedback, using reviews as a learning opportunity. - Document your work (setup steps, how systems function, known issues) to help the wider team understand and extend it. - Take part in sprint planning, stand-ups, and design discussions, and communicate blockers or risks early. - Continuously build your understanding of Unreal Engine, gameplay programming patterns, and the studio's codebase. ## Required Qualifications: - Basic working knowledge of C++. - Basic working knowledge of Unreal Engine Blueprints. - Basic familiarity with Unreal Engine (project structure, actors/components, basic editor workflow). - Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to ask questions and learn from senior team members. - Good communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment. ## Preferred Qualifications: - Basic experience with multiplayer/networked gameplay concepts in Unreal (replication, RPCs, or similar). - Experience at a professional game studio (internship or full-time), OR a degree in Computer Science or a related field. - Personal or student projects built in Unreal Engine (game jams, portfolio projects, mods). - Familiarity with source control tools (e.g., Perforce). - Passion for horror games, narrative-driven experiences, or the Poppy Playtime franchise specifically. - Interest in growing toward ownership of larger systems over time. ## Performance Expectations: - Deliver small-to-medium gameplay features and fixes reliably and on time. - Grow steadily in independence, requiring less guidance over time. - Write code that senior engineers can review and extend with minimal friction. - Actively contribute to team knowledge-sharing and documentation. ## **Salary Range:** The base salary range for this position is listed below. Final compensation within the applicable salary range will be determined based on factors such as the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and work location. **About Strada** Strada is building the operating layer for AI-driven insurance. Our platform deploys expert AI agents across calls, texts, emails, and chat - running core front-office workflows from policy servicing to claims intake. With a singular focus on insurance, Strada offers domain expertise and product depth that generic AI platforms can't match. Backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors, Strada already automates more than 1M customer interactions for leading insurers, MGAs, and brokers representing $20B+ in annual premiums. Adoption is accelerating across the industry. Insurance is one of the largest and most complex industries in the world, and modern AI has the potential to fundamentally reshape how it operates. Strada is replacing fragmented workflows with AI-native infrastructure that runs real operations at scale - at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and highly regulated real-world systems. We're a small, high-ownership team based in San Francisco, already embedded in production systems at sophisticated insurance organizations. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and shape the future of a massive industry, let's meet. **Why Insurance?** Insurance quietly powers the global economy - it helps businesses stay open, families recover from disasters, and entire industries manage risk. But the way insurance operates hasn't changed in decades. Many frontline workflows still rely on phone calls and legacy systems. We're building AI that plugs into those workflows and makes them radically faster, smarter, and more efficient. It's a $300B+ market ripe for innovation. **The Role** We're looking for a *Software Engineer Intern* to join as one of our earliest engineering hires. You'll work across the stack to build the core systems that power our AI agents – from real-time voice infrastructure to integrations with insurance platforms. This is a high-impact role where you'll ship production code from day one, learn fast, and grow alongside the company. **What you'll get done in the first week** - Ship your first PR to production (on the first day) - no months of onboarding, you're contributing from day one - Get hands-on with our voice AI stack and understand how we're automating thousands of insurance calls daily - Meet the team, shadow customer calls, and see exactly how your code impacts real users **What you'll do in your first 30 days** - Own a feature end-to-end - from scoping to shipping - that directly improves how our AI agents handle customer conversations - Optimize live systems handling real insurance workflows for major carriers - Start building intuition for the insurance domain and understand why this $1T+ industry is ripe for AI **What you'll do in your first 90 days** - Take ownership of a core product area and drive meaningful improvements independently - Contribute to launches that land in front of customers - not internal tools that sit on a shelf - Have a real seat at the table on product and technical decisions at a company that just went from $0 to $3M ARR in 18 months **What You'll Need** - Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field - Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design - Experience building software in internships, coursework, or personal projects - Comfort working across the stack – we use TypeScript, React, and Node.js - Thrive in fast-moving, high-ownership environments **Nice to Have** - Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, or telephony - Familiarity with AI/LLM-based platforms or prompt engineering - Prior experience at an early-stage startup - Contributions to open source projects **What We Offer** - Competitive salary - Macbook Pro, 4K display and all the accessories - Regular team events & offsites - Daily team dinners provided (Mon–Fri) - Gym membership **\*\*IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is on-site at our San Francisco office**

# **About Us** At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, , Nvidia, and Bridgewater. # **About the Team** This team works directly with companies building and running AI agents in production, helping turn ideas and prototypes into systems teams can rely on. This is a hands-on, highly technical team that partners closely with customer engineers across the full lifecycle, from pre-sales evaluations to post-deployment advisory work. The focus is on achieving the technical win, co-designing agent architectures, and helping customers operate agents reliably at scale using the LangChain suite. Deployed Engineers sit at the intersection of **engineering, product, and go-to-market**, shaping how LangChain is adopted in the field and feeding real-world insights back into the platform. # **About the Role** You'll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI alongside customers. You will help customers adopt innovative new practices in agentic engineering, and ensure they ship reliable agents into production, quickly. The feedback loop is fast, the impact is visible, and your work directly shapes how AI agents are built in the real world. # **What You’ll Do** - Co-architect and co-build production AI agents with customer engineering teams and customers - Own the technical win in pre-sales by designing POCs, answering deep technical questions, and guiding evaluations - Help customers deploy and operate agent-based applications such as conversational agents, research agents, and multi-step workflows - Advise customers post-sale on architecture, best practices, and roadmap-level decisions - Build and run tailored demos, trainings, and workshops for developer audiences - Surface field feedback and contribute reusable patterns, cookbooks, and example code that scale across customers - Interface with LangChain's engineering, product and design (EPD) team to share field perspectives and guide product direction based on customer priorities - Occasionally contribute code upstream when it meaningfully improves customer outcomes - This role requires 40% travel to customer sites to support deployment, onboarding, and ongoing technical engagement # **What You’ll Bring** - **1-3 years of experience** in software engineering, customer engineering, solutions engineering, founding engineering, or a similarly technical role, ideally at a startup or high-growth company - Strong **Python, JavaScript** and systems fundamentals - Hands-on experience building and deploying **agent-based or LLM-powered applications** beyond simple API calls, including multi-step workflows, orchestration, and failure handling - Strong technical communication skills and builder credibility; Can explain technical tradeoffs clearly, translate complex AI concepts into actionable insights, and build trust with technical customers and engineering teams - Excited to work directly with customers during POCs, architecture reviews, and technical evaluations - Take responsibility for **outcomes**, not just recommendations - Have a **bias toward action** and enjoy figuring things out as you go - Are excited about **shipping AI agents in production** ## **Nice to Have’s:** - You’ve deployed **AI agents in production**, especially using **LangChain, LangGraph**, or similar frameworks - Worked with **LLM evaluation, observability, or guardrails** - Have experience with **cloud environments** (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, and Kubernetes concepts - Have **shipped and operated production software** and are comfortable owning systems under real-world constraints # **Compensation** Annual OTE range: $160,000-185,000 USD **Compensation Philosophy:** We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. # Benefits Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

Who you are This impactful role involves guiding middle and high school students through self-discovery exercises, career exploration, and goal setting to help them realize their potential. As a Career Coach, you will guide in-person workshops and group coaching sessions, using an interactive and engaging approach to inspire students to define and pursue their career aspirations. This role is ideal for individuals passionate about guiding youth and helping students unlock their potential. We are looking for a diverse group of Career Coaches who can work with youth/teenagers, go through our training program and inspire students to find their passion/purpose. Term limit: detailed training is provided, 4-month unpaid internship position that fully meets requirements for school credits/ certifications with hands on experience provided (including projects, hours requirements, hands on experience and all paperwork that goes with it). Can be extendable on mutual agreement. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Career Guidance and Goal Setting: Assist students in identifying personal interests, strengths, and career goals, helping them to create personalized career development plans and set SMART goals. Facilitating School-based Programming: Lead high-energy, interactive group sessions based on a structured workshop script to engage students in self-discovery and career planning. Student Progress Monitoring: Track and evaluate students’ progress by documenting individual needs, goals, and action steps after each session to ensure continuous development. Advising on Career Pathways: Use assessments to help students evaluate their aptitudes and interests and advise them on relevant educational and career pathways. Building Resilience and Personal Development: Support students in developing resilience and a growth mindset, preparing them to overcome challenges they may face in achieving their career goals. Required Skills Active Listening: Demonstrates excellent listening skills, fully attending to students’ comments and questions to foster a supportive environment. Interpersonal and Communication Skills: Exhibits strong verbal and written communication abilities, facilitating precise, effective interactions with individuals and groups. Empathy and Patience: Works effectively with a diverse student population, showing deep empathy, patience, and understanding for students from various socioeconomic backgrounds. Organizational Skills: Manages multiple responsibilities with strong organizational skills, ensuring each session is well-structured and impactful. Rapport Building: Naturally builds trust and rapport, helping students feel valued, supported, and confident in their potential. Positive Outlook and Motivation: Brings an optimistic attitude and encourages students to reach their full potential, inspiring confidence and resilience. Assertiveness and Decision-Making: Shows confidence in guiding sessions and making timely decisions, following established procedures to support student progress. Diversity-Oriented: Embraces and respects diversity, working inclusively with students of all ages, genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds. Energetic and Enthusiastic: Maintains high energy and enthusiasm in every session, making the career exploration process engaging and exciting for students. Integrity and Trustworthiness: Upholds honesty and integrity, establishing credibility and trust in all interactions. Team Building: Encourages collaborative efforts among students, helping them work together toward shared goals. Self-motivation and Independence: Manages tasks effectively and works autonomously without direct supervision. Additional Information Participation and Availability Weekly at school coaching : Must be able to present 1-2 times a week at a designated school location for several hours. Weekly commitment of 10 hours total. Training: Weekly in-person training is provided to guide through the program. All hours are eligible for ceritification and school credits. Friendly and approachable demeanor with a solid commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive environment. Must be able to pass a background check. Location and Work Authorization Candidates must be based in Atlanta, Georgia and have legal authorization to work or study in U.S. Ideal for students/volunteers with Coaching, Counselling, Teaching, Behaviour Therapy, Training, Summer Camps and similar experiences. What we do Passion for Life is a non for profit organization that operates with the power of dedicated volunteers like you. We help under-resourced youth transform their passions into rewarding careers. Our mission is to provide forward-thinking career coaching and immersion opportunities driven by the student’s passions and talents in a fun, structured, and high-energy environment. Passion for Life was created to be a high-energy and engaging process that helps students identify their passions and gain clarity on how to utilize their core strengths and talents to select a career.

description: ### **About Profound Research** Profound Research partners with community physicians to offer clinical trials as a therapeutic option for their patients. We handle all infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and administrative operations so physicians can focus on patient care. Our model gives patients access to the newest therapies while maintaining the trusted patient-physician relationship. **Our Mission:**Improving Lives by Providing Advanced Therapeutic Options **Our Vision:**Creating the Absolute Best Patient-Physician Experience in Clinical Research **Our Values:** - **Compassion:**We prioritize the patient-physician relationship, ensuring every interaction is service-oriented and patient-centered. - **Urgency:** We work hard and practice selflessness, acting swiftly and decisively to meet the needs of our patients, partners, and colleagues. - **Solution Orientation:** We embrace challenges with a positive mindset, communicate directly, and identify and implement effective solutions with efficiency. - **Excellence:** We insist on excellence, holding ourselves accountable and empowering each other to deliver best-in-class service while maintaining the highest ethical and scientific standards. # Join Our Talent Community: Build Your Future in Clinical Research Profound Research is building a community of **recent graduates and entry-level professionals who have a foundation in clinical research and are ready to begin or continue building their careers in the field.** This includes individuals who have gained clinical research experience through internships, academic programs, hands-on research experience, or completion of a clinical research fast-track program. ***This is a talent community and expression of interest — not a current job opening.*** By joining the Profound Research **Entry-Level Clinical Research Talent Community**, you'll have the opportunity to introduce yourself to our team and be part of our network of emerging clinical research professionals. As future entry-level opportunities become available, we may connect with individuals in the community whose background, training, interests, location, and experience align with our needs. ## Where Our Talent Community Is Located We are currently building our Entry-Level Clinical Research Talent Community in and around: - Detroit, Michigan - Munster, Indiana - Las Vegas, Nevada - Southern California, including the San Diego area Candidates must currently reside in or around one of these markets to join the community. ## Why Join Our Talent Community? Clinical research brings together science, medicine, patient care, and innovation. At Profound Research, our teams support clinical trials across a variety of therapeutic areas, providing emerging clinical research professionals with the opportunity to apply their existing knowledge while continuing to develop their skills in a real-world research environment. Our research portfolio includes studies in areas such as: - Oncology - Cardiology - Neurology - Dermatology - Vaccines & Infectious Disease - Other evolving therapeutic areas By joining our talent community, you can put yourself on our radar for future opportunities and continue building upon the clinical research knowledge, training, and experience you have already developed. ## What Future Entry-Level Opportunities May Include While specific responsibilities will vary by site, study, and future opportunity, entry-level clinical research professionals may have the opportunity to: Support clinical research studies and participant visits under appropriate supervision. Assist with participant flow, including greeting participants, rooming, and preparing for study visits. Support data collection and clinical research documentation. Assist with organizing study materials, supplies, and visit documentation. Apply existing knowledge of clinical procedures such as vital signs, EKGs, phlebotomy, specimen collection, and specimen processing, as appropriate to the role. Support laboratory and specimen-related workflows. Build upon an existing understanding of how clinical research protocols are implemented in a real-world research environment. Apply and further develop knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Documentation Practices, SOPs, and regulatory requirements. Interact with study participants and contribute to a positive, patient-centered experience. Work alongside Clinical Research Coordinators, investigators, and other research professionals. Gain additional experience with clinical research systems, documentation platforms, and study workflows. Continue developing the skills and experience needed to grow within clinical research. ## Who Should Join? We're looking to connect with **recent graduates and entry-level clinical research professionals who already have foundational clinical research knowledge, training, or experience** and are interested in continuing to build a career in the field. This talent community may be a good fit for individuals who have recently completed a degree program and gained clinical research experience through an internship, academic research, or another hands-on setting, as well as individuals who have successfully completed a **clinical research fast-track or similar structured training program** designed to prepare them for entry-level clinical research work. ## What Happens After You Join? Joining the talent community is not an application for a specific position and does not guarantee an interview or employment. Once you join, your information may be reviewed as future opportunities develop. When a potential entry-level clinical research opportunity becomes available, our team may reach out to members of the community whose background, training, experience, and interests align with the opportunity. Join our **Entry-Level Clinical Research Talent Community** and let us know you're interested in continuing to build your future in clinical research. We're committed to developing the next generation of clinical research professionals — and we'd like to get to know you. **Join the Profound Research Entry-Level Clinical Research Talent Community today.** *This is a talent community and expression-of-interest opportunity, not a current job vacancy. Joining the community does not guarantee future employment or placement.*

Our model gives patients access to the newest therapies while maintaining the trusted patient-physician relationship. **Our Mission:**Improving Lives by Providing Advanced Therapeutic Options **Our Vision:**Creating the Absolute Best Patient-Physician Experience in Clinical Research **Our Values:** - **Compassion:**We prioritize the patient-physician relationship, ensuring every interaction is service-oriented and patient-centered. - **Urgency:** We work hard and practice selflessness, acting swiftly and decisively to meet the needs of our patients, partners, and colleagues. - **Solution Orientation:** We embrace challenges with a positive mindset, communicate directly, and identify and implement effective solutions with efficiency. - **Excellence:** We insist on excellence, holding ourselves accountable and empowering each other to deliver best-in-class service while maintaining the highest ethical and scientific standards. **Join Our Talent Community: Build Your Future in Clinical Research** Profound Research is building a community of students who are in the final stages of completing their degree programs who are interested in learning, connecting, and exploring future opportunities in clinical research. ***This is a talent community and expression of interest — not a current job or internship opening.*** By joining the Profound Research Clinical Research Internship Talent Community, you'll have the opportunity to introduce yourself to our team and be part of our network of emerging clinical research talent. As future internship opportunities become available, we may connect with individuals in the community whose background, interests, location, and experience align with our needs. Where Our Talent Community Is Located We are currently building our Clinical Research Internship Talent Community in and around: - Detroit, Michigan - Munster, Indiana - Las Vegas, Nevada - Southern California, including the San Diego area Candidates must currently reside in or around one of these markets to join the community. Why Join Our Talent Community? Clinical research brings together science, medicine, patient care, and innovation. At Profound Research, our teams support clinical trials across a variety of therapeutic areas, giving emerging professionals the opportunity to learn about the development and evaluation of new therapies. Our research portfolio includes studies in areas such as: - Oncology - Cardiology - Neurology - Dermatology - Vaccines & Infectious Disease - Other evolving therapeutic areas By joining our talent community, you can put yourself on our radar for future opportunities and begin learning more about what it means to build a career in clinical research. What Future Internship Opportunities May Include While specific responsibilities will vary by site, study, and future opportunity, clinical research interns may have the opportunity to: Future internship opportunities with Profound Research are paid. We are also willing to collaborate with your college or university to meet applicable internship or academic program requirements, including required hours, documentation, learning objectives, evaluations, and other school-specific requirements. Support clinical research studies and participant visits under appropriate supervision. Assist with participant flow, including greeting participants, rooming, and preparing for study visits. Support data collection and clinical research documentation. Assist with organizing study materials, supplies, and visit documentation. Gain hands-on exposure to clinical procedures such as vital signs, EKGs, phlebotomy, specimen collection, and specimen processing, as appropriate. Support laboratory and specimen-related workflows. Learn how clinical research protocols are implemented in a real-world research environment. Gain exposure to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Documentation Practices, SOPs, and regulatory requirements. Interact with study participants and contribute to a positive, patient-centered experience. Work alongside Clinical Research Coordinators, investigators, and other research professionals. Become familiar with clinical research systems, documentation platforms, and study workflows. Learn how clinical trials contribute to the development of new therapies. Who Should Join? We're looking to connect with individuals who are curious about clinical research and interested in building a career in healthcare, science, or research. What Happens After You Join? Joining the talent community is not an application for a specific internship and does not guarantee an internship, interview, or employment. Once you join, your information may be reviewed as future opportunities develop. When a potential internship opportunity becomes available, our team may reach out to members of the community whose background and interests align with the opportunity. Join our Clinical Research Internship Talent Community and let us know you're interested in being part of the future of clinical research. We're committed to developing the next generation of clinical research professionals — and we'd like to get to know you. Join the Profound Research Clinical Research Internship Talent Community today. *This is a talent community and expression-of-interest opportunity, not a current internship vacancy. Joining the community does not guarantee future employment or internship placement.*

**At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!** Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience -- so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices? In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients. **What Murj offers.** Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie. Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe. And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership. From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service. **How We Work at Murj** Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success. Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj. We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We’re not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas. **Let us leave you with this.** If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past. **About The Role.** Murj is seeking a resourceful and highly organized Junior Graphic Designer to help strengthen how our brand is created, maintained, and used across the organization. This role is about more than producing one-off designs. You will help us build a thoughtful, reusable system of brand assets, templates, and resources that enables teams to work efficiently while presenting Murj consistently. Working closely with the Head of Graphic Design and Director of Marketing, you will support a wide range of creative needs, including presentations, marketing collateral, social graphics, video, and print materials. You will primarily work within Murj’s existing visual identity while contributing ideas that help the brand and its supporting resources evolve. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong visual fundamentals with a systems-oriented mindset—someone who enjoys making great work, organizing it well, and finding solutions when the path is not already defined. **What You’ll Do.** - **Build and Manage Our Brand Asset Library:** Organize, maintain, and improve Murj’s shared library of graphics, templates, presentations, video elements, and other reusable creative resources. Establish practical systems for naming, versioning, finding, and using assets. - **Steward Brand Guidelines and Templates:** Help maintain and expand the Murj brand guide, translating brand standards into useful templates and tools for teams across the organization. Support colleagues in using those resources effectively and consistently. - **Create High-Quality Marketing Materials:** Design and refine presentations, campaign graphics, sales and marketing collateral, graphic elements, and other materials based on the needs of the design and marketing teams. - **Support Social and Digital Content:** Create engaging, on-brand graphics for social media and digital campaigns, with an emphasis on developing reusable systems rather than rebuilding common assets each time. - **Edit and Create Video Content:** Help clean up, edit, assemble, and prepare video content for marketing, social, sales, and internal use. Create titles, graphic elements, and simple motion treatments as appropriate. - **Prepare and Refine Print Materials:** Produce polished, print-ready materials and ensure files meet visual, technical, and production requirements. - **Explore Smarter Creative Workflows:** Help Murj evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-enabled creative tools into its brand and asset workflows. Look for practical ways to improve efficiency while maintaining quality, accuracy, and brand consistency. - **Support Website and Special Projects:** Contribute visual assets and design support for Murj’s upcoming website work and other cross-functional initiatives. This role is not primarily focused on product UI, but familiarity with web design or Figma is valuable. **What Makes You a Great Fit.** - **A Systems Mindset:** You enjoy organization, clear naming conventions, and turning one-off designs into scalable, reusable templates. - **Resourcefulness:** Faced with an unfamiliar tool or assignment, you take the initiative to research, experiment, and figure it out. - **Balanced Stewardship:** You collaborate smoothly with non-design stakeholders, incorporating their input while protecting brand consistency. - **Versatility:** You easily switch contexts—moving between presentation decks, video edits, social graphics, and asset management without missing a detail. - **Modern Workflow Curiosity:** You are excited to test new tools, automation, and AI features to work smarter and cut down on repetitive tasks. **What You Bring.** - Graphic design experience demonstrated through a strong portfolio, internships, freelance work, or comparable projects. - A portfolio demonstrating strong typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and attention to detail across digital and print work. - Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign. - Experience creating and refining presentations in PowerPoint or Google Slides. - Experience with shared asset libraries or digital asset-management systems. - Working knowledge of print-production requirements and file preparation. - Strong organizational skills and an interest in building clear, reusable systems for assets and templates. - The ability to receive feedback, manage multiple assignments, and follow work through to completion. - A resourceful, curious approach to unfamiliar tools or assignments—you are comfortable researching, experimenting, and figuring out how to move the work forward. - Strong collaboration and communication skills. **Nice To Haves.** - 2-3 years of relevant graphic design experience. - Motion graphics or animation experience, particularly in After Effects. - Experience editing video using Premiere Pro or a comparable tool. - Familiarity with Figma, website design, or digital design systems. - Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and responsible creative-use practices. - Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS. - Experience in healthcare, SaaS, or another technical industry. **What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days).** During your first 90 days, success means learning Murj’s brand, becoming a reliable creative partner, and beginning to improve how our design resources are organized and used. You will have: - Built a working understanding of Murj’s brand, products, audiences, and visual standards. - Audited existing brand assets, templates, and shared resources and identified opportunities to improve their organization and usability. - Established an initial structure for maintaining, naming, updating, and distributing commonly used assets. - Updated or improved priority templates and internal brand resources. - Begun delivering dependable creative support across presentations, graphics, social content, video, and print projects. - Started positively influencing how teams find, use, and apply Murj’s brand assets. - Identified practical opportunities to improve creative workflows, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools. **Location and schedule.** This is a remote-friendly position; however, the role requires core working hours of **8:00 AM – 5:00 PM i**n the employee's timezone to support our clinical customers and internal teams. **Travel expectations:** 1-10%: Minimal to no travel; maybe a few meetings or events

## FPGA ENGINEER (NEW GRAD SUMMER 2027) Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits. As an FPGA Engineer at Freeform, you will play a key role in developing and deploying the software systems that power our autonomous metal 3D printing factories. You’ll work with a talented engineering team from some of the world’s most innovative companies across a range of projects including controls, high-speed data acquisition, high-performance computing (GPU’s and FPGA’s), and geometry processing pipelines that enable precise and fully automated manufacturing at scale. Your work will directly impact the performance, reliability, and scalability of our factory systems. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative on complex technical problems, and works collaboratively across disciplines to deliver robust, high-performance software solutions. This is an opportunity to build foundational systems for a new category of manufacturing technology - where your code doesn’t just run, it drives physical innovation. 3D printing experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving hard problems and creating amazing technology! **Responsibilities:** - Developing new logic components for use on FPGAs - Implementing custom algorithms on FPGAs for signal processing - Implementing custom controllers on FPGAs - Working with other software engineers to develop embedded Linux applications to interface with FPGA logic components - Packaging and using IP components in FPGA block diagram design - Working both on development boards and in a production environment **Basic Qualifications:** - Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or computer science - Hands on electrical experience from internships or engineering clubs such as FSAE, Baja SAE, solar car, rocket club, robotics club, or similar - Experience developing in VHDL or Verilog **Nice to Have:** - Experience with Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale+ MPSoC - Familiarity with Xilinx Vivado/Vitis toolchain development environment - Experience with embedded software development including embedded Linux and System on Chip (SoC)-based architectures - Experience with heterogeneous computing platforms and high-speed data acquisition systems - Familiarity with C/C++ or other high-level programming languages - Excellent verbal and written communication skills - Creative thinker able to apply first-principles reasoning to solve complex problems **Location:** - Based in Hawthorne, our vertically integrated facility brings technology development, R&D, and production together under one roof. We operate at the center of LA’s deep tech ecosystem, surrounded by some of the most ambitious hardware innovation happening anywhere in the country. - Our fast-paced, cross-functional environment is built on close collaboration, and as such, this role requires full-time onsite presence (five days a week), with very limited exceptions. **What We Offer:** - We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data-driven decisions. - We offer a unique opportunity to be an early and integral member of a rapidly growing company that is scaling world-changing technology. - Benefits - Significant stock option packages - 100% employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (premium PPO and HMO options) - Life insurance - Traditional and Roth 401(k) - Relocation assistance provided - Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays - Generous Paid Parental Leave and extended transition back to work for the birthing parent - Free daily catered lunch and dinner, and fully stocked kitchenette - Casual dress, flexible work hours, and regular catered team building events - Compensation - Our intent is to offer a salary that is commensurate for the company’s current stage of development and allows the employee to grow and develop within a role. - In addition to the significant stock option package, the estimated salary range for this role is $125,000-$150,000, *dependent on the candidate's academic level (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) and demonstrated out of classroom experience*. - Freeform is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity; employment with Freeform is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

**Overview** Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of university interns from every corner of the world. As an Applied Scientist Intern at Microsoft, you will be at the forefront of technological innovation, working collaboratively to bring research to life in our products and services. You'll gain expertise in cutting-edge research areas, apply advanced concepts to real-world needs, and use state-of-the-art tools to make a tangible impact on product quality and business outcomes. You'll contribute to the creation of intelligent solutions through data analysis, modeling, machine learning, and/or AI, LLM, SLM and agent, ensuring our products remain at the leading edge of innovation. As an intern at Microsoft, you’re stepping into a world of real impact from day one. You’ll collaborate with global teams on meaningful projects, explore cutting-edge technologies like AI, and kick start your career while doing it. With a strong focus on learning and development, this is your opportunity to grow your skills, build community, and shape your future—all while being supported every step of the way. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate and empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Please note this application is only for internships based in our Redmond, Washington office. For internships in other offices in the United States, please see our [Careers site](http://www.microsoft.com/university). **Responsibilities** - Analyze and improve performance of advanced algorithms on large-scale datasets and cutting-edge research in machine intelligence and machine learning applications. - Think through the product scenarios and goals, identify key challenges, then fit the scenario asks into Machine Learning (ML) tasks, design experimental process for iteration and optimization. - Implement prototypes of scalable systems in AI applications. Gain an understanding of a broad area of research and applicable research techniques, as well as a basic knowledge of industry trends and share your knowledge with immediate team members. - Prepare data to be used for analysis by reviewing criteria that reflect quality and technical constraints. Reviews data and suggests data to be included and excluded and be able to describe actions taken to address data quality problems. - Assist with the development of usable datasets for modeling purposes and support the scaling of feature ideation and data preparation. - Help take cleaned data and adapt for machine learning purposes, under the direction of a senior team member. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field. - Must have at least one additional quarter/semester of school remaining following the completion of the internship. - Candidate must be enrolled in a full time bachelor’s, master’s degree program in area relevant for the role during the academic term immediately before their internship. **Preferred Qualifications:** - Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field. #EiP The base pay range for this internship is USD $5,690.00 - $11,210.00 per month. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $7,410.00 - $12,250.00 per month. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. role: Industrial Maintenance Technician III Day Rotational Shift
description: JOB DETAILS Rotational Day Shift: 3am-3:30pm Pay: $30-$40 per hour DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Maintenance Technician III is an Electro-Mechanical position and responsibilities will include but not be limited to supporting manufacturing operations, adjusting and repairing equipment as needed, tracking usage of and ordering replacement parts. Diagnose and repair complex electro-mechanical problems with manufacturing equipment Perform detailed setup on equipment including recipe changes and control adjustments Repair and keep mechanical machine components in top operating condition Advanced understanding of electrical principles such as voltage, current and resistance Diagnose and repair electrical control circuits, field devices, sensors, photo eyes, etc. Advanced understanding of electrical safety and motor control circuits and programmable drives Troubleshoot the inputs and outputs on PLC and repair issues Complete projects to add electrical circuits and controls, new equipment and relocate machines Maintain and repair pneumatic systems including repairs of cylinders and other components Perform simple to complex mechanical Preventative Maintenance Tasks following instructions Enter all work completed in computer-based maintenance program Monitor and report spare parts usage including completing parts order forms Adjust equipment based on Statistical Process Control data and team with QA Train Level I and II technicians in more complex tasks and skills Performs other duties as assigned Associates degree in related field is desired 3-7 years’ maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment Knowledge of and experience with Lock-Out, Tag-Out procedures Able to strictly adhere to safety policies/procedures and be committed to customer quality. Must be available for regular standby assignments; work scheduled off-hours and emergency overtime as required. Proficient in Word and Excel Must be willing to attend training sessions as needed, including out of state locations Ability to assist in Training Level I and II Technicians Intermediate knowledge of fabrication (ex. welding, basic machining) Possess strong work ethic and knowledge of intermediate troubleshooting Able to read printed materials, blueprints, schematics, and computer graphics Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work independently and within a team, including the ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships employees, vendors, contractors, and suppliers Ability to show attention to detail in a very fast paced environment Flexible and willing to work overtime as required Physical Demands: The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with qualified disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. Must possess strength, stamina and mobility to perform heavy physical work with exposure to potentially hazardous conditions, use varied hand and power tools, drive a motor vehicle and/or light construction equipment, fork trucks, platform lifts etc. Lift and move materials and equipment weighing up to 90 pounds and heavier weights with the use of proper equipment While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk; use fingers and hands to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop and kneel; talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand and sit for long periods, as well as occasionally be required to climb or balance. role: 2027 BT RISE Internship - Legal Operations Intern
description: **Summary:** Our team leads the integration of business strategy, innovation, and project management into the practice of law. Recognized by [](http://Law.com) as the Best Business Team for innovation in Big Law, we are driving how large law firms deliver services more efficiently and effectively. This internship offers an incredible opportunity to gain hands-on experience in legal operations. You’ll collaborate with senior professionals to help manage complex legal and business projects, ensuring operational excellence across the firm. As one of the largest law firms globally, Barnes & Thornburg’s Legal Operations team plays a crucial role in delivering top-tier service to major global companies. Under the supervision of the Department Chief and a dedicated mentor, you will work on project-based assignments aligned with your field of study and the firm’s strategic priorities. This role provides invaluable real-world experience in the evolving field of legal operations. **Internship Eligibility:** The BT R.I.S.E. Internship Program is designed to introduce students in specified fields of study to the day-to-day operations of a law firm. Candidate’s skill, knowledge, aptitude, and education will be considered during the selection process. To be eligible candidates must be: - Enrolled in either a 2 or 4 year degree program - Entering their junior or senior year in Fall of 2027 - Available to participate for 10 consecutive weeks **Key Responsibilities:** - **Project Coordination**: Support the planning, execution, and tracking of legal and business projects, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met. - **Process Improvement**: Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose solutions to enhance efficiency within the Legal Operations team. - **Data Analysis**: Analyze project data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide insights and recommendations for ongoing projects. - **AI Solutions**: Work with the firm’s approved AI tools to create and collaborate on AI solutions both for the business and legal sides of the firm. - **Attorney Collaboration**: Work with attorneys to understand possible process and technology opportunities to assist with their clients and practices. - **Cross-Departmental Collaboration**: Work internally within Legal Operations teams and externally with departments such as Finance, Marketing, and IT to collect insights, streamline workflows, and drive key initiatives forward. - **Project Documentation**: Assist in maintaining comprehensive project documentation, including timelines, reports, and status updates to ensure stakeholders are informed. - **Presentation Skills**: Prepare and present project status reports, highlighting key milestones, challenges, and results. As such, it is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of job duties or responsibilities required in this job. The requirements may vary occasionally, depending on the needs of the firm. The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. role: Sample Receiving Technician (Entry-level/Non-degree) - Eurofins Environment Testing Northeast - North Kingstown, RI
description: Performs sample handling in accordance with state and local EPA regulations. Participates in performing tasks related to sample receipt, storage and disposal as well as shipping samples to outside laboratories. Responsibilities: Follow laboratory standard operating procedures (SOPs) in the handling and disposal of samples. Light laboratory duties Perform sample receiving duties including, but not limited to: sample documentation upon receipt, sample storage and sample disposal. Effectively communicate with Sample Receiving Manager on sample receipt related discrepancies including but not limited to: incorrect bottle type / preservation, additional containers not listed on the chain of custody and reporting when sample receipt temperature is out of spec Packing and shipping samples Preparing client bottle orders Assists laboratory with glassware cleaning for all departments. Assists chemists and other technicians as needed. Perform all responsibilities in a safe and responsible manner in accordance with Eurofins Laboratory safety policy. Maintains a safe and healthy work environment that is in compliance with the requirements of Eurofins Laboratory’s Health & Safety program (and local laws and regulations). Utilizing computer based laboratory information system to electronically track and store sample containers and for shipping purposes Performs all responsibilities in an organized and timely manner in strict accordance with courier arrival times, sample hold times and with the nightly Fedex pickup Basic Minimum Qualifications (BMQ): High school diploma or GED Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) experience helpful The ideal candidate would possess: Computer skills Organizational skills and attention to detail Strong communication (oral and written) Ability to work in a fast-paced production setting Learn quickly Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, and comply with company policies Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds Requirements: Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English Position is full-time 2nd shift Monday – Friday 1:30 pm - 10:00 pm. Will train on 1st shift Monday - Friday 9:00 am - 5:30 pm for 1-2 weeks. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of North Kingstown, RI are encouraged to apply. Pay range: $18-20/hr. Please note - Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base salary of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location. As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. we offer excellent benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options. *The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee's full-time or part-time regular status. To learn more about Eurofins, please explore our website . We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development. We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler. Find out more in our career page: Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and Eurofins Scientific 2/2 March 2023 agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. Eurofins USA Environment Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Opportunity Reporting to the Student Recruitment and Enrollment Manager and in partnership with the school-based Operations team, a Student Recruitment Ambassador supports regional student recruitment and enrollment strategy. KIPP Columbus seeks enthusiastic, detail-oriented and mission-driven individuals for the role of KIPP Student Recruitment Ambassador that offers an opportunity to develop professionally and help expand the school’s community. Student Recruitment Ambassadors will receive leadership training to support the implementation of student recruitment and outreach activities and create sustaining connections with new families in the school’s community. Through a part-time commitment of 25 hours per week, Student Recruitment Ambassadors will work both as a team and one-on-one with School Operations teams to connect with the broader community, help raise the awareness and visibility of KIPP Columbus, and support the drive toward the school’s student recruitment goals. This role is a temporary and flexible part-time hourly position that requires work on some weekends, evenings and/or holidays. Community Outreach and Engagement Actively participate in and represent KIPP Columbus at external events, such as fairs, open houses, and community events in order to engage with families, answer inquiries, share information about our school’s programs and offerings, and encourage families to apply. Research and identify opportunities to attend community events that align with KIPP Columbus’s recruitment priorities and provide opportunities to connect with prospective families and support application goals. Identify and plan for opportunities to participate in events throughout the school year that increase KIPP Columbus’s visibility and connect us with prospective families. Help strengthen KIPP Columbus’s presence in the communities we serve by sharing our mission, schools, programs, and opportunities with families and community members. Support the organization and hosting of events that welcome prospective families, community organizations, and community leaders to the KIPP Columbus community. Internal Engagement Actively participate in our internal family events, serving as a point of contact for families, addressing any concerns or questions they may have, and encouraging families to promote KIPP Columbus’s programs and opportunities. Student Recruitment Activities Collaborate with Regional and School Ops leaders to prepare and implement outreach activities to recruit new families and students to KIPP, including flyering, canvassing and tabling in the school community. Participate in and help lead recruitment activities, including community events, tabling, flyering, canvassing, school tours, information sessions, and other outreach efforts. Hold 1:1 conversations with current and prospective families to answer questions, share information about KIPP Columbus, build interest, and help families take the next step toward applying. Serve as a welcoming and knowledgeable point of contact for prospective families throughout the recruitment process. Help generate applications through community events, recruitment activities, and direct outreach. Track and communicate family interest and recruitment activity to support timely follow-up and lead management. Lead Management Follow up with families who express interest at community events, recruitment events, or through other outreach efforts. Support the conversion of prospective family interest into completed applications by answering questions, addressing barriers, and connecting families to the appropriate KIPP Columbus team members when needed. Maintain accurate and timely information about family interactions and follow-up needs. Experience: Current, past, or future parent of a KIPP student preferred Outreach and communication experience is preferred Experience working as part of a team in a professional setting Knowledge/skills required: 100% aligned with the mission and values of KIPP Columbus Credible amongst peers and a connector mindset. Excited to learn and grow Results oriented Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to connect authentically with a wide range of families and community members. Comfortable initiating conversations with new people and representing an organization in public settings. Warm, welcoming, and engaging communication style. Ability to represent KIPP Columbus professionally and enthusiastically at community and recruitment events. All Student Recruitment Ambassadors will be required to submit a background check to KIPP Columbus prior to the start of employment. Classification Temporary and flexible part-time hourly position; 25 hours per week; includes the possibility of some evening, weekend and/or holiday work. Compensation $15.00 per hour up to a maximum of 25 hours per week. The position is not eligible for benefits, holiday or break pay. KIPP Columbus does not discriminate on the basis of disability, gender, nationality, race or ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that is contained in the definition of hate crimes set forth in Section 4112.02 of the Ohio Revised Code. KIPP, the Knowledge Is Power Program, is a national network of free, open enrollment, college preparatory public schools dedicated to preparing students in underserved communities for success in college and life. There are 285 KIPP schools across the nation and the District of Columbia, serving more than 175,000 students and alumni with more than 15,000 educators. Founded in 2008 with 50 students in 5th grade, KIPP Columbus currently educates 2,000 students in grades Kindergarten through twelfth. With a mission to, together with families and the community, create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose -- college, career, and beyond -- KIPP has maintained excellence in its growth, and will improve upon that standard – proving what is possible in public education. KIPP Columbus continues to rank as one of the top schools for academic growth of any school in the state of Ohio, and is a top performing urban school in the state for academic growth. In our first three graduating classes (in spring 2020, 2021, and 2022) 100% of students were accepted to college and/or military service with nearly $40 million in merit scholarships from colleges and universities awarded. In addition to academic excellence, KIPP Columbus also partners with nearly 100 community organizations to provide extracurricular activities, programming, health and wellness services, meals, and more to KIPP students, families, and the broader community. KIPP is also a member of the Ohio High School Athletic Association, offering more than 10 varsity sports. The KIPP Columbus learning campus will continue to advance student learning, expand partnerships, enable superior programming, and serve as a teaching and leadership lab for schools nationwide, reimagining education through a deeper lens of antiracism, excellence, and joy as we expand to educate nearly 4,000 students on our learning campus in the coming years. *Full-time Co-op (≥6 months) · In person · Boston, MA (Seaport)* **About Kernal Biologics, Inc.** Kernal Bio is a venture-backed therapeutics company engineering cells inside the body using AI-designed, selective mRNA and targeted lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technology. By developing in vivo CAR-T therapies, Kernal Bio is advancing precision treatments for autoimmune diseases and blood cancers. The company was founded by experts from MIT, Harvard, Merck, and BMS, and its leadership team brings a track record of three FDA-approved therapies and over 120 patents. With support from leading investors, including Hummingbird Ventures, Amgen Ventures, Y Combinator, and HBM, Kernal Bio is transforming the future of cell therapy design and delivery. **Job Summary** Kernal Bio is seeking a highly motivated Co-op to join our LNP team. The successful candidate will play an integral role in advancing next-generation mRNA-LNP therapeutics, contributing to routine production and analysis, LNP formulation, antibody conjugation, process development, and analytical characterization. This position offers hands-on experience across multiple manufacturing functions and the opportunity to work alongside experienced scientists and engineers driving the future of selective, programmable mRNA medicines. The role also includes assisting with authoring and reviewing key documentation, such as protocols, batch records, and SOPs. **Key Responsibilities** - Support routine mRNA and LNP production, purification, and analytical testing - Assist with LNP formulation and optimization, including process development and scale-up - Contribute to antibody–LNP conjugation and associated analytical characterization workflows - Participate in process development and analytical method development for mRNA-LNP products - Draft, review, and maintain documentation (SOPs, protocols, batch records) - Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless data sharing and process execution - Maintain precise and organized lab records - Maintain human and murine cell lines: sterile technique, passaging, cell counting and viability, cryopreservation - Transfect IVT mRNAs and LNP-formulated mRNAs into mammalian cells and quantify expression by flow cytometry **Qualifications** - B.S. or M.S. student in Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, or a related field - **Required:** Familiarity with mRNA/LNP unit operations (e.g., in vitro transcription, chromatography, normal flow filtration, tangential flow filtration). Hands-on mammalian cell culture experience at the bench (sterile technique, passaging, transfection, viability assays), not coursework alone - ≥6 months of previous laboratory experience strongly preferred - Experience with molecular biology techniques (PCR, cloning, gel electrophoresis) and/or assays such as flow cytometry is a plus - Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work full-time (35-40 hours/week) on site in Boston’s Seaport throughout the ≥6-month Co-op - Eagerness to grow and develop as a scientist **Benefits** - Compensation: $20-25/hour based on experience - Free monthly subway pass - Free Bluebikes membership - Gym membership support - On-site cafeteria **Equal Employment Opportunity** Kernal is dedicated to providing a diverse work environment and is committed to equal employment opportunity for all its employees and qualified applicants. We do not discriminate in employment practices for reasons of race, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, religion, disability, or any other legally protected status. RTP Semiconductor Process Engineering Intern – Photolithography and Metrology Role Overview: As a member of the Photolithography and Metrology process engineering team, the Process Engineering Intern will work alongside experienced engineers providing mentoring, guidance, and introductions to colleagues. This Internship with MACOM will help the Intern to gain valuable work experience in a key discipline, build professional relationships, and take ownership of a business-critical project. During the 12 weeks each Intern will: Be given an individual and well-defined project with set outcome goals Gain hands on experience Receive excellent training and ongoing supervision Be invited to attend an intern webinar series Attend networking/social events Attend and present at Poster Session about each Interns project successes and pitfalls Receive formal, written feedback Requirements: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, materials science, or equivalent. Prerequisite Skills and Experience: Strong foundational knowledge of semiconductor fabrication processes and cleanroom protocols. Familiarity with process control concepts and statistical analysis. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Effective communication skills, both written and verbal. Additional Desirable Skills: Photolithography fundamental knowledge and/or experience in spin coat, expose, develop and the associated metrology Hands-on experience with semiconductor process equipment or lab-based process development. Understanding of Design of Experiments (DOE) and root cause analysis techniques (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams). Exposure to Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing principles.
