Overview Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington. With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality. At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems. The Grady Lab at Fred Hutch is seeking a highly motivated Bioinformatics Trainee to contribute to our ongoing studies on mapping the colorectal cancer progression sequence using the multi-omic approach. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on research experience in translational cancer biology, bioinformatics, and epigenetics. Responsibilities Communicate with researchers and identify appropriate bioinformatics tools to meet the needs of proposed research projects. Perform bioinformatics analysis on datasets. Conduct statistical analysis and generate visualizations to summarize findings. Document research methods, maintain accurate records, and contribute to data interpretation. Collaborate with faculty mentors and team members to develop research questions and analytical approaches. Provide support to Fred Hutch statisticians, bioinformaticians, and computational biologists. Participate in lab meetings, journal clubs, and research discussions. Provide figures & written sections describing methods and results for manuscripts, presentations, and grant applications generated by Fred Hutch researchers Assist in preparing scientific presentations, reports, and potential publications. NOTE: The role is only open for applicants from a Bioinformatics/Genomic Program from an accredited University. Applicants must also provide a letter from the University validating enrollment in the program as part of the application process. Qualifications MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, bioinformatics, biology, genetics, computational biology, statistics or related discipline. Experience with data analysis in R, Python, or another relevant programming language. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a research team. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated, perform in a highly independent manner, and possess strong interest in the biological sciences. The hourly pay range for this position is from $32.04 to $45.63 and pay offered will be based on experience and qualifications.Although Fred Hutch is not sponsoring most H-1B visas at this time, candidates who already hold an H-1B sponsored by another organization and are currently in the U.S. may be eligible for this position.Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center offers employees a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits include medical/vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, life, disability, retirement, family life support, employee assistance program, onsite health clinic, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation (12-22 days per year), paid sick leave (12-25 days per year), paid holidays (13 days per year), and paid parental leave (up to 4 weeks). Artificial intelligence is changing war - making decisions in combat quicker and more accurate, while enabling information to be shared more rapidly across both America’s and her adversaries’ militaries. Modern Intelligence builds Sovereign, the first defense-purpose foundation AI for unmanned systems, to be the standard battlefield AI on every Western unmanned system. Today, Sovereign allows drones as varied as unmanned vessels on water to backpack attack quadcopters to see, decide, and act even when jammed. We believe the responsibility of reliably and ethically building lethally autonomous AI is immense to our service members, the American people, and civilians everywhere. Modern Intelligence has worked with partners across the Department of War including the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, Special Operations Command (SOCOM), the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering, and countless unmanned systems hardware companies. We have raised more than $22M in venture capital from Exponential, Oxford Funds, Bedrock, Vine Ventures, Contrary, Air Street, Caffeinated, Champion Hill, Swell, Myelin, and others. ### Details We are looking for a software engineer excited to take technology demonstrated on test ranges and relatively peaceful theaters and see it proven on the battlefield. We have a small software team, but are looking to grow it rapidly. We are seeing significant increase in customer engagement and are looking to expand capacity on an established team. We need engineers willing to travel and support field deployments and integrations. And importantly, we want to take our product to and prove it in Ukraine. Our product, Sovereign, is an Automated Target Recognition and Automated Terminal Guidance solution that works on any platform in any domain - we are currently working to expand its capability to meet any autonomy requirement for any unmanned system. We are looking for engineers passionate about drones, autonomy, supporting our service men and women, and defending democracy and freedom around the world. ### Requirements - Proficiency in a compiled systems language: C++, Rust, or C. Our primary codebase is C++20; we do not expect you to know C++20 on day one, but we do expect you to already think in terms of memory, types, and build artifacts. - Comfortable writing Python. - Comfortable developing on Linux: command line, git, and code review. - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or comparable, or equivalent demonstrated experience. - Willingness to travel and support field deployments and integrations. - Must be a U.S. person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)). This role works on export-controlled technology. ### Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Bazel, or with CMake and an appetite for learning Bazel. - Applied linear algebra: coordinate frames, covariance, Kalman filters, geodesy. - Experience with Docker and containerized builds. - Experience with video pipelines: GStreamer, ffmpeg, RTSP/RTP/etc. - Experience with an inference runtime such as ONNX Runtime or TensorRT. - Experience with CUDA or GPU programming. - Experience with cross-compilation and embedded Linux, such as Jetson and ARM targets. - Experience with protobuf and/or gRPC. - Experience with TypeScript and React (our operator UI), or with PyTorch (our model training and export) ### Nice to have - Experience with Dart and Flutter. - Experience targeting ML accelerators: Hailo, Qualcomm QNN, XNNPACK, ARM Compute Library. - Experience building for Windows, macOS, or Android. - Experience with MAVLink or other drone software. - Experience with Slurm or other cluster training workflows. - Prior defense industry experience, or an active or previously held clearance.

Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads. Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter! If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders. Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light! The Photonics & Silicon Engineering team's core function is the design and development of Lightmatter's photonic processors and interconnects using light instead of electrical signals for computation and communication. They specialize in silicon photonics fabricating advanced optical components directly onto a silicon base to deliver chips and lasers with superior speed, low power and higher overall performance. The team's innovations are critical for eliminating data bottlenecks in next-generation AI and high-performance computing Lightmatter is looking for a PhD candidate who can work in Photonics Characterization (Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field) starting immediatelywith a strong understanding of Silicon Photonics and demonstrated experience in electro-optic testing of components like micro-rings and Mach-Zehnder interferometers. The ideal candidate will leverage hands-on laboratory experience with various optical and semiconductor test equipment, and be skilled in developing and implementing automated testing using Python scripting. This highly analytical, process-oriented individual must be capable of working independently to solve complex technical problems and translate data into actionable strategies. ### Responsibilities - Participate in electro-optic testing of photonics chips/devices, leveraging hands-on laboratory experience and working with various optical instruments. - Conduct tests and characterization of silicon photonics components, including micro-rings, optical phase shifters, and Mach-Zehnder interferometers. - Operate a range of optical equipment such as lasers, electro-optic modulators, semiconductor optical amplifiers, PIN receivers, optical spectrum analyzers, optical vector analyzers, and optical filters. - Utilize semiconductor test equipment, including vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, source-meter units, arbitrary waveform generators, and high-speed oscilloscopes. - Design and execute testing protocols for silicon photonics chips and subsystems. - Develop and implement automated testing and system interfacing through Python scripting. ### Qualifications - **Recent PhD graduate OR PhD candidate in Photonics with a strong understanding of Silicon Photonics and demonstrated experience in electro-optic component testing.** - Experienced in developing and implementing automated testing systems using Python scripting, with a proven ability to translate data into actionable strategies. - Highly analytical, process-oriented, and capable of working independently to solve complex, non-obvious technical problems in a lab environment. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ### Preferred Qualifications - Microcontroller programming - Experience with high speed instruments - High speed communications and understanding of VNA and optical link - Understanding of high speed PCBs and/or micro electronics - Experience working in a graduate level photonics or electrical engineering lab. - Willingness and curiosity to learn from an exciting team! We offer competitive compensation. The base salary range for this role determined based on location, experience, educational background, and market data. Hourly Range $53—$65 USD ### Benefits - Comprehensive Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision) - Retirement Savings Matching Program - Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D) - Generous Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays) - Paid Family Leave - Short Term & Long Term Disability - Training & Development - Commuter Benefits - Flexible, hybrid workplace model - Equity grants (applicable to full-time employees) Benefits eligibility may vary depending on your employment status and location. description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the [admissions process](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/application-process/) early! ### **About the Role** [FREOPP](https://freopp.org/) is seeking a highly motivated intern to serve as an Operations Intern in our growing organization. This is a hands-on, high trust role for someone who enjoys learning quickly, solving problems, and bringing structure to a fast paced environment. The Operations Intern will work closely with senior staff and contribute across a wide range of organizational functions, including operations, development, research, scheduling, data management, and special projects. Because FREOPP is a rapidly growing organization, this is not a traditional administrative internship. While the role includes important backend responsibilities that keep the organization running, the Operations Intern will also be trusted with meaningful responsibilities, independent projects, and opportunities to improve how FREOPP operates. The role is intentionally broad and dynamic. The successful candidate should be comfortable handling both routine details and unfamiliar problems, and should approach both with the same level of care. ### **About FREOPP** The Foundation for Research on Equal Opportunity (FREOPP) is a nonprofit think tank that produces policy research and practical implementation strategies designed to expand opportunity for Americans who need it most. FREOPP advances policy ideas that: - address the needs of individuals with wealth or income below the national median; - have the potential to earn bipartisan support; and - increase individual liberty. Through rigorous analysis and practical implementation strategies, FREOPP develops durable policy solutions across healthcare, welfare reform, child welfare, housing, K–12, higher education, and more that expand opportunity and strengthen individual agency. **This is an in person role at our Washington, D.C. office.** ### Responsibilities **Operations & Executive Support** - Support the daily operations of a growing policy organization. - Coordinate meetings, calendars, correspondence, and organizational logistics. - Maintain accurate records and ensure recurring processes are completed reliably and on time. - Assist with event planning, office administration, and other operational needs. **Development & External Engagement** - Support donor and prospect management through CRM maintenance, correspondence, scheduling, and research. - Assist with external communications and donor related projects. - Maintain and improve organizational databases and tracking systems. **Research & Special Projects** - Assist with occasional research and execution of special projects. - Take ownership of development projects from initial research through implementation. **Systems & Process Improvement** - Identify opportunities to improve organizational workflows, databases, and internal systems. - Research and implement tools and processes that help FREOPP operate more effectively. - Develop and maintain trackers, SOPs, and other resources that create consistency and organization. - Document processes to improve future onboarding and continuity. **Wherever Needed** - Jump in wherever needed. The Operations Intern may be asked to tackle anything from financial administration and event planning to research and organizational problem solving. ### Who We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who: - Is humble and dependable and understands that both small details and larger projects matter. - Takes initiative and has an “I’ll figure it out” attitude. - Learns quickly and is comfortable asking questions. - Is highly organized and detail oriented. - Communicates clearly and professionally. - Can independently manage recurring responsibilities and follow through reliably. - Enjoys creating order out of chaos. - Is willing to take on unfamiliar or unglamorous tasks when necessary. - Is comfortable working in an environment where processes are still evolving. - Brings a positive attitude and works well with a close knit team. - Wants to grow professionally and become a meaningful contributor to the team. **Prior professional or internship experience is not required.** We are more interested in judgment, work ethic, curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to learn than in an extensive resume. ### What You’ll Gain The Operations Intern will have the opportunity to: - Work directly with senior staff at a growing policy organization. - Take on meaningful responsibility rather than simply shadowing or completing routine intern assignments. - Gain exposure to development, operations, policy research, and organizational strategy. - Learn how a small organization operates across multiple functions. - Develop practical skills in systems, project management, research, CRM management, and process improvement. - Contribute ideas and help improve the way FREOPP works.

Internship Summary NinjaHoldings is seeking an Intern to join our Marketing Analytics team, partnering with Marketing and senior analytics experts. You’ll support the data pipeline—updating Snowflake data models, assisting with Periscope dashboard builds and automations, and using SQL/Python to analyze funnel performance and identify drop-off drivers. Your insights will help inform clear, data-driven recommendations for leadership and guide cross-functional testing and optimizations. Our internship program offers an opportunity to work on real projects that move the business forward while receiving hands-on professional development. When: May-August 2027 Location: Hybrid, downtown Chicago HQ (in-office 2x/week). Candidates must be local or able to relocate independently - relocation assistance is not provided. Schedule: 40 hours/week Key Responsibilities: Monitor key funnel metrics through reports and dashboards to track channel performance, diagnose deviations, and surface root-cause insights Use SQL and Python to analyze funnel trends, quantify drop-off drivers, and provide recommendations to optimize Communicate findings in a clear, concise way to stakeholders Assist in updating and maintaining DBT data models in Snowflake to streamline reporting Help enhance Periscope dashboards by adding new charts and metrics to improve visibility across the marketing funnel Partner with Marketing, Risk, and Engineering to implement strategy changes, monitor releases, and conduct post-release impact analysis Ideal Candidate Will Have: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail. Strong ability to write queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Must be comfortable with joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions. role: KIP Spring 2027 - State Policy Intern - Pacific Legal Foundation
description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the [admissions process](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/application-process/) early! ### General Information The Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, PLF battles for freedom in the nation’s capitols, courts, and the court of public opinion. As a national nonprofit law firm, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. **Interns work remotely by default, but they can request to work physically in any of PLF’s offices. Interns are expected to work part time (24 hours per week).** **You:** An inquisitive, creative, and self-motivated college junior, senior, grad student, or recent graduate who knows the principles of liberty and seeks to advance them. You have strong written and oral communication skills and enjoy problem solving. **Them:** Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there, and it’s backed by seemingly endless resources. **Us:** We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the U.S. Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 cases heard by the Court. PLF also has nearly 200 active cases across the nation. Since 2024, PLF’s state-policy team has capitalized on our Supreme Court wins and helped pass 96 bills across 41 states by testifying, refining bill language, and guiding local allies toward victory. At PLF, we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game. As a member of the State Policy team, you will work with all PLF’s capabilities—litigation, strategic research, coalitions, and communications—to draft legislation, model bills, one-pagers, research memos, and blogs and op-eds supporting our mission and vision. **Your specific job duties will likely include**: - Conducting legislative and other research to support policy drafting - Drafting one-pagers, op-eds, blogposts, and other supporting documentation for PLF’s model policies - Reviewing legislation and providing support to the State Policy team **This role is ideal for someone with:** - Curiosity about the law and public policy - Knowledge of and a principled passion for individual liberty, one that transcends private or other political interests - Strong writing and research skills ### ### How to Apply **If you think you might be a good fit, submit in ONE PDF:** - A résumé that includes relevant experience in the liberty movement and professional skills. - A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants. Applicants selected for an interview may be asked to provide: - A writing sample. - A semester schedule (if taking classes during the internship period).

**About Nominal** Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world's most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development, so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers, from autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI to next-generation aerospace teams like Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports, alongside mission partners within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure isn’t an option. We’re backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. **The role** We’re looking for students with solid engineering fundamentals interested in a Summer 2027 internship and on track to graduate in Summer 2028 or sooner. As a software engineering intern at Nominal, you’ll have an unparalleled opportunity to work closely with world-class engineers solving high-impact problems. As part of an early-stage company, you’ll help us grow, launch new products, and take on exciting challenges. You’ll have a front-row seat as our customers test and validate complex hardware systems like nuclear reactors, rockets, and supersonic aircraft. ### ### ### **🚀 What you’ll do** - Dive deep into cutting-edge data infrastructure, focusing on high-frequency, high-volume multi-modal hardware data - Design and build new features in close collaboration with our customers, often working directly with our users in the field - Quickly take ownership of projects from start to finish, while receiving mentorship from our world-class engineers and domain experts - Take the driver’s seat at an early-stage company, helping Nominal grow, onboarding new customers, and expanding its product offerings, while contributing to our mission of accelerating the testing and validation landscape for complex hardware systems ### ### **🎯 Reach out if…** - You are targeting a 12-week internship in Summer 2027, full-time work starting in 2028 - You have a personal passion for solving challenging problems and contributing to the future of critical infrastructure - You have exceptional hands-on experience and strong core engineering skills — whether through internships, personal projects, or academic work - Your peers would describe you as ambitious, resourceful, and perseverant ### ### **✨ Benefits/Perks** - Receive mentorship from our world-class team - Trips to co-locate with the team across our different offices - Free lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks - A beginning-of-internship swag bag and an end-of-internship intern gift - In-office hardware lab with a $250 project stipend *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.* ITAR Requirements *To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR* [*here*](https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987)*.*

Vast is developing next-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. ### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. #### **About the NPI Team** The New Product Introduction (NPI) team moves hardware design changes and brand-new products from concept development through large-scale production and commercial use. We coordinate across design, testing, supply chain, quality, manufacturing, and field operations to ensure products are ready to build, launch, and scale in support of Zipline’s mission. #### **About The Role** This role on the Change Management/NPI team will help us level up our ability to process and implement changes at high volume and high change velocity. Zipline’s unique ability to quickly improve our hardware and develop new designs allowed us to launch our hardware so successfully, and this role with unlock our ability to expand across the United States and beyond while maintaining the same design improvement velocity. **What You'll Do** - Build a tool that visualizes hardware changes over time, shows how product configurations evolve, and highlights hardware capabilities at specified timestamps. - Build a tool that evaluates configuration compatibility across current and previous hardware revisions and summarizes hardware capabilities for specified configurations. - Build a user interface for submitting engineering changes that standardizes required information, reduces errors, and generates complete change summaries for technical and non-technical audiences. #### **What You'll Bring** - Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, information systems, data science, or a related technical field. - Demonstrated experience through coursework, personal projects, research, student organizations, or prior internships building software, data, dashboard, or automation tools. - Familiarity with at least one technical tool or language used to build solutions, such as Python, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, spreadsheets, databases, or low-code application platforms. - Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships, dependencies, and business rules within complex, multi-level assemblies or product data. - Ability to gather requirements from users, ask clarifying questions, and turn ambiguous problems into clear workflows, visualizations, or user-friendly interfaces. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document information, explain technical outputs to non-technical audiences, and incorporate feedback from technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to validate data, manage changing priorities, and work independently and collaboratively on complex projects. #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May/June to August/September.**Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.* *The hourly rate for this internship is $40 per hour.* Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements. *Candidates are limited to **three (3) applications within a 30-day period.*** Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. # **Chart Your Journey at Secretariat** From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT THE FIRM** Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world. From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions. Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT Our Damages & Valuations team** Our Damages & Valuations team sits at the intersection of finance, data, strategy, and the law. We help clients answer high-stakes questions when businesses, investors, and legal teams need to understand what something is worth, how much money may have been lost, and what the financial evidence really shows. Our work supports complex disputes, arbitration matters, and business challenges around the world—giving team members exposure to real-world problems where their analysis can directly influence important decisions. As part of this team, you will collaborate with accountants, economists, PhDs, business valuation experts, investment analysts, and industry specialists to investigate complex issues, analyze data, and translate financial information into clear, persuasive insights. It is challenging, fast-moving work that helps early-career professionals build consulting skills quickly, learn from recognized experts, and see how their work connects to major business and legal outcomes. The team’s work is highly regarded: Secretariat was ranked #1 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2024 and 2025, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by *Who's Who Legal*. **RESPONSIBILITIES** In this role, you will be part of a growing domestic and international practice where strong analytical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and clear communication are essential. Associates are actively involved in meaningful project work from the start—helping the team uncover facts, analyze financial information, and develop insights that support high-stakes client matters. - Dig into case documents, research materials, and discovery records to understand the facts behind complex disputes - Analyze financial statements, business records, market data, and other evidence to help quantify damages and support valuation work - Build models, organize data, and develop analyses that help explain financial issues clearly and accurately - Contribute to reports, presentations, and client-ready materials that turn detailed analysis into compelling insights - Work closely with senior consultants and experts, gaining hands-on experience in litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, and economic consulting This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving puzzles, working with numbers, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how financial analysis can make a real impact in business and legal settings. The ideal candidate is coachable, intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a collaborative consulting environment. **QUALIFICATIONS** - Pursuing bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another analytically rigorous discipline from an accredited college or university - Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn new concepts and ask thoughtful questions - Interest or experience in economic consulting, litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, finance, accounting, data analysis, or other research-intensive work - Experience with research projects, undergraduate theses, consulting internships, data analytics internships, finance-related work, or similar experiences that demonstrate ownership of complex work - Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with tools such as Stata, R, Python, or SQL is helpful, along with an eagerness to continue building technical skills - Comfort working with data, conducting research, organizing information clearly, and using emerging tools, including AI, to improve efficiency, quality, and analytical rigor - Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to balance multiple assignments and communicate proactively - Ability to stay focused, adaptable, and solutions-oriented when priorities shift or deadlines are tight - Clear listening, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a thoughtful and professional way; fluency in English for business communication is required - Interest in professional development or credentials such as CPA, CFA, CVA, or ASA is a plus, but not required to apply - Authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship ## A rewarding career above all There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure. Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself. [Our people](https://secretariat-intl.com/people/) are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world. From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions. Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT Our Damages & Valuations team** Our Damages & Valuations team sits at the intersection of finance, data, strategy, and the law. We help clients answer high-stakes questions when businesses, investors, and legal teams need to understand what something is worth, how much money may have been lost, and what the financial evidence really shows. Our work supports complex disputes, arbitration matters, and business challenges around the world—giving team members exposure to real-world problems where their analysis can directly influence important decisions. As part of this team, you will collaborate with accountants, economists, PhDs, business valuation experts, investment analysts, and industry specialists to investigate complex issues, analyze data, and translate financial information into clear, persuasive insights. It is challenging, fast-moving work that helps early-career professionals build consulting skills quickly, learn from recognized experts, and see how their work connects to major business and legal outcomes. The team’s work is highly regarded: Secretariat was ranked #1 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2024 and 2025, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by *Who's Who Legal*. **RESPONSIBILITIES** In this role, you will be part of a growing domestic and international practice where strong analytical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and clear communication are essential. Associates are actively involved in meaningful project work from the start—helping the team uncover facts, analyze financial information, and develop insights that support high-stakes client matters. - Dig into case documents, research materials, and discovery records to understand the facts behind complex disputes - Analyze financial statements, business records, market data, and other evidence to help quantify damages and support valuation work - Build models, organize data, and develop analyses that help explain financial issues clearly and accurately - Contribute to reports, presentations, and client-ready materials that turn detailed analysis into compelling insights - Work closely with senior consultants and experts, gaining hands-on experience in litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, and economic consulting This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving puzzles, working with numbers, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how financial analysis can make a real impact in business and legal settings. The ideal candidate is coachable, intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a collaborative consulting environment. **QUALIFICATIONS** - Currently pursuing bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another analytically rigorous discipline from an accredited college or university - Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn new concepts and ask thoughtful questions - Interest or experience in economic consulting, litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, finance, accounting, data analysis, or other research-intensive work - Experience with research projects, undergraduate theses, consulting internships, data analytics internships, finance-related work, or similar experiences that demonstrate ownership of complex work - Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with tools such as Stata, R, Python, or SQL is helpful, along with an eagerness to continue building technical skills - Comfort working with data, conducting research, organizing information clearly, and using emerging tools, including AI, to improve efficiency, quality, and analytical rigor - Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to balance multiple assignments and communicate proactively - Ability to stay focused, adaptable, and solutions-oriented when priorities shift or deadlines are tight - Clear listening, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a thoughtful and professional way; fluency in English for business communication is required - Interest in professional development or credentials such as CPA, CFA, CVA, or ASA is a plus, but not required to apply - Authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship At Secretariat, we believe in pay transparency and equity. Compensation for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, and location. Further details will be provided during the hiring process. Pay Transparency $20—$30 USD ## A rewarding career above all There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure. Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself. [Our people](https://secretariat-intl.com/people/) are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers. To learn how Secretariat collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our [Privacy Policy](#)

**Company Overview:** Beam Therapeutics is a biotechnology company committed to establishing the leading, fully integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. To achieve this vision, Beam has assembled a platform with integrated gene editing, delivery and internal manufacturing capabilities. Beam’s suite of gene editing technologies is anchored by base editing, a proprietary technology that is designed to enable precise, predictable and efficient single base changes, at targeted genomic sequences, without making double-stranded breaks in the DNA. This has the potential to enable a wide range of therapeutic editing strategies that Beam is using to advance a diversified portfolio of base editing programs. Beam is a values-driven organization committed to its people, cutting-edge science, and a vision of providing life-long cures to patients suffering from serious diseases. **Position Overview:** Beam is seeking a highly energetic, talented, and motivated Quality Co-op to join our Quality team from January through June 2027. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to Quality Systems through rotations in both Document Control and Supplier Management. The co-op will work closely with cross-functional teams while supporting key quality processes and initiatives, providing a holistic view of how Quality functions support Beam's mission and operations. **Responsibilities:** Document Control/Training - Quality Assurance Co-op for external collaborations will help provide quality system expertise and help identify solutions and ensure compliance to GMP. - Work collaboratively with cross functional teams, partners, and vendors to gather background knowledge needed to complete assignments. - Support the draft and review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related GMP documents. - Participate in system improvement initiatives to optimize the business processes and practices within Veeva. - Participate in projects to support Quality Systems department holistically. - Assess document metadata within Veeva for missing data and facilitate clean-up. - Assist in organization of the Document Archival Room and enter paper archives into a database for tracking. - Assist in logbook cleanup around site. - Create Person Records and assign initial learner roles. - Run the Veeva/Success Factors report and make any needed changes. - Create Micro-learning trainings for wide personnel use. - Create flow charts for all process areas. - Document metadata updates (based on the +12K documents unassigned for product/stage/impacted departments). - Assess GR records to solidify retention of all document types within the archived lifecycle. - Curriculum Periodic Review. - Assist with Learner Role/Curriculum Consolidation. Supplier Management: - Support BEAM-101 and BEAM-302 supplier commercialization activities. - Assess authorized vendor qualification status. - Complete Veeva supplier qualification documentation. - Support reassessment of approximately 282 existing forms/records. - Identify gaps and create replacement/new assessments as required. - Align supplier risk assessments and vendor classifications. - Document commercial-readiness status. - Support SCN intake, assessment, tracking, and follow-up. - Support associated Change Controls. - Maintain visibility of aging and overdue actions. - Track supplier audit responses and CAPAs. - Follow up on overdue commitments. - Review supporting evidence. - Maintain audit records and closure documentation. **Qualifications:** - Pursuing a BA in Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, or related field. - Prior industry internship or academic lab-based research experience is preferred. - The candidate should have a solid academic foundation in science and laboratory coursework (examples: biology/chemistry/biochemistry, biochemical/bioengineering, microbiology, tissue culture, molecular biology, etc.) - A team player who is curious, motivated to learn, organized, and possesses strong communication skills. - This role follows a hybrid work schedule and requires onsite attendance 4-5 days per week. - Applicants must be currently enrolled in a degree-granting college or university program and maintain their student status throughout the duration of the co-op to be eligible. Hourly pay will will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education. Co-op Hourly Pay Range $23—$30 USD

### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. #### **About the NPI Team** The New Product Introduction (NPI) team moves hardware design changes and brand-new products from concept development through large-scale production and commercial use. We coordinate across design, testing, supply chain, quality, manufacturing, and field operations to ensure products are ready to build, launch, and scale in support of Zipline’s mission. #### **About The Role** This role on the Change Management/NPI team will help us level up our ability to process and implement changes at high volume and high change velocity. Zipline’s unique ability to quickly improve our hardware and develop new designs allowed us to launch our hardware so successfully, and this role with unlock our ability to expand across the United States and beyond while maintaining the same design improvement velocity. **What You'll Do** - Build a tool that visualizes hardware changes over time, shows how product configurations evolve, and highlights hardware capabilities at specified timestamps. - Build a tool that evaluates configuration compatibility across current and previous hardware revisions and summarizes hardware capabilities for specified configurations. - Build a user interface for submitting engineering changes that standardizes required information, reduces errors, and generates complete change summaries for technical and non-technical audiences. #### **What You'll Bring** - Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, information systems, data science, or a related technical field. - Demonstrated experience through coursework, personal projects, research, student organizations, or prior internships building software, data, dashboard, or automation tools. - Familiarity with at least one technical tool or language used to build solutions, such as Python, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, spreadsheets, databases, or low-code application platforms. - Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships, dependencies, and business rules within complex, multi-level assemblies or product data. - Ability to gather requirements from users, ask clarifying questions, and turn ambiguous problems into clear workflows, visualizations, or user-friendly interfaces. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document information, explain technical outputs to non-technical audiences, and incorporate feedback from technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to validate data, manage changing priorities, and work independently and collaboratively on complex projects. #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Spring 2027 interns from January to April.* *Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.* *The hourly rate for this internship is $40 per hour. **About Us** At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space. The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy. ## **About the Summer Internship Program** Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater. Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else. We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer. We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules: **Cohort #1** Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13 **Cohort #2** Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10 All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements. Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package. **About the Team** As a Nuclear Engineering Intern, you will work directly on the design and analysis of Antares reactors. You will contribute to reactor design efforts while helping develop and validate the computational physics capabilities used to inform engineering decisions. Interns will be tasked with small starter projects, and then quickly tasked with a long-duration project that will culminate in a technical deliverable and presentation. You will be integrated and evaluated as if you are a first-year junior engineer, not just an “intern”. The bar for success here is high, and the expectation is that you’re able to smartly use your mentor and the resources around you to execute on your project and identify more issues and opportunities for improvement. **Roles and Responsibilities:** - Drive reactor design work by performing nuclear engineering analyses that inform design decisions. - Develop and validate computational physics capabilities used to analyze and evaluate reactor designs. **Basic Qualifications:** - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies. - 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience) **Preferred Skills & Experience:** - GPA of 3.5 or above. - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred. - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.). - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams. - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements. - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively. **Location** - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. **Culture** At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful: - *Think in Systems* - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - *Obsess over the End User* - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle - *Be Unconstrained by Convention* - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done” - *Go Where the Work I*s - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together - *Operate in the Grey* - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption **Equal Opportunity** Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status. ## **ITAR Requirements** To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR [here](https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987).

You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else. We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer. We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules: **Cohort #1** Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13 **Cohort #2** Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10 All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements. Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package. **About the Team** Antares is developing compact nuclear reactors to deliver reliable power in the world’s most demanding environments. We’re looking for an Electrical Engineering Intern to support the design and testing of the electrical systems that make those reactors work. You will begin with focused starter projects before taking ownership of a longer-term project culminating in a technical deliverable and presentation. Interns are integrated into the engineering team and evaluated with expectations similar to those of a first-year junior engineer. The bar for success is high: you will be expected to use your mentor and available resources effectively, execute independently, communicate clearly, and identify additional issues and opportunities for improvement. **Roles and Responsibilities:** - Redesign printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) for new reactor systems - Develop schematics, select components, and support PCB layout and design reviews - Design electrical harnesses, including wiring diagrams, connector selection, pinouts, and routing - Build and test prototype boards, harnesses, and electrical assemblies - Develop and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) tests - Support the buildout of system-level test infrastructure for hardware qualification. - Troubleshoot electrical hardware and identify root causes of failures - Analyze test data and recommend design improvements - Create clear design, test, and configuration documentation - Work closely with electrical, mechanical, controls, and test engineers to integrate designs into larger systems **Basic Qualifications:** - Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field - 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience) **Preferred Skills & Experience:** - Familiarity with circuit design, schematics, and PCB development - Experience building, testing, or debugging electrical hardware through coursework, a student team, research, or personal projects - Understanding of common electrical test equipment, such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and logic analyzers - Ability to read electrical drawings, datasheets, and technical documentation - Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work directly with hardware - Clear written and verbal communication - Experience with Altium Designer or another PCB design tool - Experience designing cable harnesses or selecting connectors - Familiarity with embedded systems, microcontrollers, or common communication protocols - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing or automated test systems - Familiarity with Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar test and analysis tools - Experience working on a Formula SAE, rocketry, robotics, CubeSat, or other hands-on engineering team **Location** - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. **Culture** At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful: - *Think in Systems* - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - *Obsess over the End User* - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle - *Be Unconstrained by Convention* - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done” - *Go Where the Work I*s - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together - *Operate in the Grey* - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption **Equal Opportunity** Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. description: ![](https://click.appcast.io/greenhouse-te8/a31.png?ent=34&e=22630&t=1701374353806) ![](https://track.jobadx.com/v1/i.gif?utm_pixel=224e990b-8ff4-4287-8d5d-2ff09647f181&utm_ptz=EST&utm_rqt=track) ## **About the Team** At DoorDash, design shapes how millions of people connect with their local economy and we put our customers at the center of our product strategy. Our design team crafts thoughtful experiences across the ecosystem, from consumers ordering their favorite meals to merchants growing their businesses and Dashers delivering with care. ## **About the Role** Design is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and we’re building the team that defines what comes next. As a New Grad Product Designer, you’ll join and learn from designers shaping this new practice — one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship. You’ll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Dashers, collaborating with product, research, data, and engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. You’ll join one of our core teams — Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, Customer Experience & Integrity. You’ll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow. This is a full-time role starting in 2027 and relocation support will be available as needed. ## **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** - Grow faster than you thought possible – with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end: experiment with how AI evolves your work and process, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Dashers. - You’ll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship – leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human. - You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new grads, what you figure out won’t just shape your own projects — it will shape how design is practiced across the team. - Hone and refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration. - Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation. ## **We're excited about you because…** - You’re graduating with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) by Summer 2027, and available to start full-time in 2027. - You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals — visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving. - AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience. - You communicate through prototypes — using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly. - You’re excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback. Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis **Compensation** Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others. To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page [here](https://careers.doordash.com/). See below for paid time off details: - **For salaried roles:** flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year. - **For hourly roles:** vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week). The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado. $105,400—$155,000 USD ## About DoorDash At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. ## Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
