Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights ([tech report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332)). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read [A Third Path: Protocol Learning](https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/). This setting breaks nearly every assumption of datacenter training and inference: communication-efficient training across different parallelism axes, fault tolerance as nodes join and drop mid-run, heterogeneous compute and networks, and robustness to malicious participants. Our published methods include [Subspace Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01260), [Factored Gossip DiLoCo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22768), [AsyncMesh](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22442), and [Sentinel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03592). As a Research Scientist Intern you join us for a 6-month, fixed-term research internship during your PhD, focused on publishing. You work on the problems that stay open as we push from the 8B run toward frontier scale, with access to significant compute and focused mentorship from senior scientists. These are foundational papers up for grabs. ## Key Responsibilities - **Publish in Tier-1 venues**: Conduct novel research in Protocol Learning with the explicit goal of publishing in tier-1 ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). - **Own a real problem**: Pick a question that blocks Protocol Learning at scale and answer it — the internship is scoped so a foundational paper is a realistic outcome, not a stretch goal. ## What We're Looking For - **Publication track record (required)**: Current PhD candidate with at least one publication in top-tier ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). - **Research focus**: You work in a core technical area relevant to frontier models. - **Technical depth**: Strong theoretical understanding of deep learning and distributed systems principles. - **Implementation skills**: Proficiency in PyTorch and experience with large-scale training infrastructure. - **Mission alignment**: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI. ## FYI's - This is a 6-month, fixed-term research internship. We only hire in Australia and the US, and visa sponsorship is limited to these countries. - We work remotely across the world, with the main teams in Australia and North America. You'll need to be comfortable working across timezones. - Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken). - Recruiters: we aren't looking for agency support at this time. We'll reach out if we need help. *We are backed by* [*Union Square Ventures*](https://www.usv.com/) *and other tier-1 investors, and we are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We believe AI, and the world, end up on a better path if we succeed in implementing the protocol for intelligence. If this resonates, please apply.*

## About Nuvo **We’re Redefining the $11T B2B Commerce and Payments Market** Nuvo is bringing B2B commerce online. While technology has reshaped consumer commerce, the business-to-business (B2B) economy — three times larger— has lagged behind. From coffee to lumber, every product we use has been traded through a complex supply chain of suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers. Despite the massive scale of this market, most businesses manage their trading relationships and commerce activities using outdated methods like paper forms, PDFs, emails, faxes, phone calls, and spreadsheets, making processes slow and inefficient. Much like how Shopify, Stripe and Square have transformed how consumer companies transact, we aim to do the same for B2B companies. ## About the Role We are looking for smart engineers to help build category-defining products. Our problems span scaling AI agents, multi-agent workflows that automate risk and payments, and running agents on large scale data. You'll partner with our engineering, design and product teams to help shape the roadmap, solve real world problems and build our 0-1 products. Your work will have huge impact: on team culture, on our customers and on the economy. **What You’ll Do:** - Build the AI systems that automate real trade workflows: collections, credit decisioning, payments operations, and the manual work that slows the physical economy down. - Turn LLMs and agents into reliable, production-grade features, not demos, with the evals and guardrails to back them. - Write high-quality, clean and performant code and partner with platform and product engineers to ship end to end. - Help shape how Nuvo builds with AI as both the field and our product move quickly. - Use the best tools for the job. What matters is whether the system works in production, not which model or framework you used. **What You Bring:** - Strong CS fundamentals plus hands-on experience building with modern ML or LLMs (coursework, research, internships, or projects you can show). - Good judgment about where AI genuinely helps versus where it adds risk, and a rigorous approach to evaluating output quality. - The ability to communicate technical solutions and tradeoffs clearly. - Excitement to work in an early-stage team solving ambiguous problems with a strong bias for action.

**Katalyst Description:** Katalyst is an American technology company focused on dynamic space operations. We are building a fleet of dual-use multipurpose robotic space vehicles to create the future where maneuvering, upgrading, refueling, resupply and exploration are as routine as they are on Earth. Getting to space and overcoming the gravity well is only half the story. What you do there is the future. We are not building the trains. We are building the machines that lay down the tracks. By developing the foundational capabilities that make sustained, responsive operations possible, we enable a new era of space exploration that strengthens national security and ensures freedom of action in an increasingly contested domain. **Katalyst Culture:** Working at Katalyst is intense, hands-on, and deeply rewarding. You’ll take real ownership and see your work move from concept to operations in an environment where the problems are hard and the impact is real. We value humility, craftsmanship, and doing things the right way, even when it’s harder. You’ll work closely with thoughtful, driven teammates who push each other to do their best. Oh, and we're dog friendly! **Benefits:** - Stock options & equity - Medical, dental, and vision coverage - 401(k) - Unlimited PTO - Catered lunches **What You’ll Do** - Contribute to real spacecraft engineering work in one of four technical tracks: Electrical, Mechanical, GNC, or Software, with assignments sized appropriately for an internship. - Work alongside experienced engineers on scoped technical problems involving design, analysis, implementation, integration, test, simulation, debugging, or engineering documentation. - Gain hands-on exposure to flight hardware, test equipment, software environments, simulations, engineering data, and the processes used to take spacecraft from concept through test and operations. - Participate in design reviews, test activities, technical discussions, and team meetings; ask thoughtful questions and communicate progress, assumptions, risks, and blockers clearly. - Collaborate across disciplines to understand how electrical, mechanical, software, controls, mission operations, and program constraints interact at the spacecraft level. - Apply classroom fundamentals to real engineering decisions and compare models, calculations, code, or design intent against test results and practical constraints. - Document analyses, code, drawings, procedures, test results, or technical decisions so the work can be reviewed and used by the broader team. - Demonstrate increasing independence over the course of the internship while seeking feedback early and maintaining ownership of assigned work. - Create repeatable capture and partnership mechanisms that allow Katalyst to scale national security business development without becoming dependent on informal relationships or individual heroics. **What We’re Looking For** **Required** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Applied Math, Physics, or a closely related technical field. - Strong academic foundation in the fundamentals relevant to the selected discipline and the ability to explain technical reasoning clearly. - Demonstrated technical interest through coursework, laboratories, research, student teams, capstone work, personal projects, prior internships, or other hands-on experience. - Ability to break down a technical problem, identify assumptions, ask useful questions, and make progress with guidance from more experienced engineers. - Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to distinguish personal contributions from the work of a broader team. - Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools, systems, and technical domains quickly. - Ability to collaborate effectively, receive direct technical feedback, and follow through reliably on commitments. - Ability to comply with applicable export-control requirements and customer-access restrictions. **Your Ideal Background** **Preferred** - Prior internship, co-op, research, student-team, or project experience in spacecraft, aerospace, robotics, autonomous systems, defense technology, high-reliability hardware, or another technically demanding environment. - Experience designing, building, coding, analyzing, testing, or debugging something beyond normal classroom problem sets. - Electrical track: exposure to circuits, embedded systems, PCB design, power electronics, sensors, test equipment, controls hardware, or hardware-in-the-loop environments. - Mechanical track: exposure to CAD, mechanisms, structures, thermal or structural analysis, manufacturing, GD&T, test fixtures, or hardware integration. - GNC track: exposure to dynamics, controls, estimation, navigation, orbital mechanics, simulation, MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or C/C++. - Software track: exposure to C/C++, Python, Linux, embedded or real-time software, networking, testing, simulation, robotics, autonomy, or mission / ground software. Additional Requirements: Must be available for the defined internship term and willing to work hands-on in the office, lab, integration, or test environment as required. Occasional extended hours may be needed during critical test or mission activities. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at Katalyst. You will also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of the Employee Stock Option and Equity Plan, as well as a relocation bonus and other discretionary bonuses. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, and unlimited Paid Time Off. *At Katalyst our work on projects involving the U.S. Department of Defense requires adherence to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), 22 C.F.R. Parts 120-130, which requires compliance with U.S. export laws before allowing employees to perform certain positions. Currently, our available roles necessitate access to ITAR-controlled information, and as a result, Katalyst would have to ensure any non-US person is authorized access to ITAR information before the commencement of employment. description: ### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. #### **The Role** Every Zipline market grows differently. Customer behavior, commercial priorities, competition, partnerships, and local opportunities vary from city to city. We're looking for a Commercial Strategy & Operations Intern to help turn those local realities into clear priorities, better decisions, and measurable market growth. You'll support the team responsible for understanding how your market is performing and where we can improve. You'll work with data, build analyses and reporting, contribute to planning, and help make sure cross-functional teams are aligned on the work that matters most. Success means helping the organization move faster, operate more effectively, and identify opportunities to improve customer, merchant, and market performance. You'll partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Marketing, Analytics, Community Engagement, and other teams across the organization. You'll learn how a fast-growing marketplace business works while gaining hands-on experience solving ambiguous problems and translating insights into action. **What You'll Do** - Support weekly and monthly business reviews by pulling data, analyzing performance, and turning findings into clear takeaways and actions. - Build and maintain reporting on key customer, merchant, commercial, and ops metrics. - Analyze customer behavior, merchant performance, market trends, and operational data to identify opportunities and risks. - Help develop business cases, forecasts, and recommendations for growth and operational initiatives. - Partner with cross-functional teams to coordinate priorities, document decisions, track action items, and follow up on execution. - Improve processes, templates, and operating rhythms that help teams plan and execute more effectively. - Research competitors, local market dynamics, and emerging opportunities to inform commercial strategy. - Prepare concise presentations and ad hoc analyses for leadership and partner teams. - Own a defined commercial strategy or operations project from problem framing and analysis through recommendation and implementation support. #### **What You'll Bring** - Must have completed the second year of a bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, data analytics, engineering, marketing, or a related field. Master’s are also eligible. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex questions and communicate the answer clearly - Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL, dashboards, or other data tools is a plus. - Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders. - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting findings and recommendations. - Curiosity about how businesses grow and how strong operating practices turn strategy into results. - A proactive, collaborative approach and willingness to take ownership in a fast-moving environment. - Prior internship, campus leadership, project, or work experience involving analysis, operations, strategy, or cross-functional collaboration is a plus. - Must be able to work onsite and travel frequently throughout Austin, Texas, San Antonio, Texas, Houston, Texas or Phoenix, Arizona. Requires transportation (not company provided) and the ability to independently travel to operational sites, events, communities, and partner locations as needed. #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our Dallas, Texas, Austin, Texas, Los Angeles, California OR Phoenix, Arizona office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns (May/June - August/September).* *Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.* The hourly rate for this internship is $30 per hour. Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements. *Candidates are limited to **three (3) applications within a 30-day period.*** Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process. ### **Voluntary Self-Identification** For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

description: ### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. #### **The Role** Every Zipline market grows differently. Customer behavior, commercial priorities, competition, partnerships, and local opportunities vary from city to city. We're looking for a Commercial Strategy & Operations Intern to help turn those local realities into clear priorities, better decisions, and measurable market growth. You'll support the team responsible for understanding how your market is performing and where we can improve. You'll work with data, build analyses and reporting, contribute to planning, and help make sure cross-functional teams are aligned on the work that matters most. Success means helping the organization move faster, operate more effectively, and identify opportunities to improve customer, merchant, and market performance. You'll partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Marketing, Analytics, Community Engagement, and other teams across the organization. You'll learn how a fast-growing marketplace business works while gaining hands-on experience solving ambiguous problems and translating insights into action. **What You'll Do** - Support weekly and monthly business reviews by pulling data, analyzing performance, and turning findings into clear takeaways and actions. - Build and maintain reporting on key customer, merchant, commercial, and ops metrics. - Analyze customer behavior, merchant performance, market trends, and operational data to identify opportunities and risks. - Help develop business cases, forecasts, and recommendations for growth and operational initiatives. - Partner with cross-functional teams to coordinate priorities, document decisions, track action items, and follow up on execution. - Improve processes, templates, and operating rhythms that help teams plan and execute more effectively. - Research competitors, local market dynamics, and emerging opportunities to inform commercial strategy. - Prepare concise presentations and ad hoc analyses for leadership and partner teams. - Own a defined commercial strategy or operations project from problem framing and analysis through recommendation and implementation support. #### **What You'll Bring** - Must have completed the second year of a bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, data analytics, engineering, marketing, or a related field. Master’s are also eligible. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex questions and communicate the answer clearly - Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL, dashboards, or other data tools is a plus. - Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders. - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting findings and recommendations. - Curiosity about how businesses grow and how strong operating practices turn strategy into results. - A proactive, collaborative approach and willingness to take ownership in a fast-moving environment. - Prior internship, campus leadership, project, or work experience involving analysis, operations, strategy, or cross-functional collaboration is a plus. - Must be able to work onsite and travel frequently throughout Austin, Texas, San Antonio, Texas, Houston, Texas or Phoenix, Arizona. Requires transportation (not company provided) and the ability to independently travel to operational sites, events, communities, and partner locations as needed. #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our Dallas, Texas, Austin, Texas, Los Angeles, California OR Phoenix, Arizona office. We will host our Spring 2027 interns from (January 2027 - April 2027).**Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.* The hourly rate for this internship is $30 per hour. Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements. *Candidates are limited to **three (3) applications within a 30-day period.*** Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. ## WHAT MAKES US EPIC? At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development. ## ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES ### **What We Do** Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize. ## FRONTEND PROGRAMMER INTERN ### **What You'll Do** The Social Web team builds the interfaces players use to connect with other players across Epic's ecosystem, including Fortnite, Rocket League, and Fall Guys. As an intern on the team, you'll ship real features that touch millions of players, gaining hands-on experience with production web development while being mentored through the full lifecycle of a feature, from design to deployment. ### **In this role, you will** - Build and ship features using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, working directly in our production codebase - Partner with senior engineers to design and implement UI components and user flows for the social overlay experience - Debug issues and contribute fixes across the front end, with guidance from your team - Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to build strong engineering habits - Take ownership of a well-scoped project or feature over the course of your internship, from planning through to shipping ### **What we're looking for** - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field - Coursework or project experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript - Familiarity with React or another modern front-end framework - A strong interest in distributed systems *This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit [](https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/earlycareers). The team drives pricing, forecasting, partner deal structuring, user and partner economics, and scenario planning across both core revenue channels and emerging products like Zipline Marketplace. Blending analytical rigor with cross-functional influence and an entrepreneurial mindset, Strategic Finance uncovers growth opportunities, improves efficiency, and strengthens long-term business value. The team is based at Zipline’s South San Francisco headquarters in an in-person/hybrid environment. #### **The Role** As a Strategic Finance Intern supporting Operations Finance, you will play a key role in helping Zipline understand and optimize the financial performance of our global operations. You’ll work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Data teams to build analyses, streamline reporting, and develop insights that directly influence strategic and operational decisions. This role is ideal for someone who loves solving complex problems, is comfortable with data, and wants hands-on exposure to how a hardware-enabled, technology-driven business operates. **What You'll Do** - Support Operations Finance with metric development, reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling - Query and analyze large operational datasets using SQL (Snowflake experience a plus) - Build repeatable dashboards and tools in Excel, Google Sheets, and BI platforms to drive visibility into performance - Partner with operations leaders to understand drivers of cost, efficiency, and performance across global sites - Support ad-hoc analyses related to operational efficiency, unit economics, and scaling strategies - Assist in month-end processes, variance analysis, and KPI reviews - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives involving Supply Chain, Product, and Data teams - Help improve internal processes by identifying gaps and implementing simple automation or workflow improvements #### **What You'll Bring** - A strong analytical mindset with comfort getting into the details and understanding how complex operations function - Experience with SQL, relational databases, and working with large datasets (Snowflake preferred; experience with dbt or modern data stacks is a plus) - High proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets; ability to build and manage structured and dynamic financial models - Strong communication skills—comfortable interacting with cross-functional partners who have diverse backgrounds and perspectives - Ability to work with imperfect information and drive clarity in a fast-paced environment - Strong organizational skills and a desire to create processes that bring structure and accountability - Interest in hardware-focused or technology-enabled businesses; experience in technology, healthcare devices, or operations-heavy industries is a plus - Knowledge of financial statements, accounting fundamentals, and core financial analysis concepts (e.g., unit economics, scenario analysis, return on capital) - A “general athlete” mentality—eager to jump into a wide variety of problems and learn quickly - Prior experience in operational finance, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or analytics is a plus, but not required #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We are looking for an MBA Intern, Development & Strategy to join our world-class team. The Opportunity Soluna's growth depends on finding the right sites before anyone else does. Every week, inbound leads arrive from independent power producers, renewable developers, landowners, and brokers — and our team sources many more. Most of them will not work. A small number are exceptional. The difference between the two is a disciplined screen: is there curtailed or low-cost power, is there a credible path to interconnection, is there land, fiber, and water, and does the arithmetic clear our return threshold? This internship owns the front end of that funnel. You will take raw leads, run them through Soluna's qualification criteria, build a first-pass economic screen, and produce a clear recommendation on whether the opportunity advances to full diligence or gets a fast, well-reasoned no. The modeling is deliberately light — enough to size the opportunity and pressure-test the assumptions, not a full project finance build. Speed and judgment matter more than precision at this stage. This is a high-ownership role on a small team: your screens will be read by the people who decide where Soluna builds next. What You'll Do Lead Qualification & Screening Run inbound and sourced leads through Soluna's qualification framework — power cost and curtailment profile, interconnection status and queue position, land control, fiber and water availability, and counterparty credibility. Produce a standard one-page qualification summary for each lead so the team can make a go / no-go call quickly and consistently. Recommend advance, park, or pass on every opportunity you touch, with the reasoning written down — including the reasoning behind the passes. Maintain the lead intake queue so nothing sits unreviewed and the team always knows what is waiting. Light Financial Modeling Build first-pass economic screens for qualified sites — estimated cost of power, capacity sizing, indicative capex, and top-line return. Run sensitivities on the variables that actually move the answer , such as energy price, curtailment hours, hashprice or contracted AI/HPC revenue, and time to energization. Pressure-test counterparty assumptions against market data and flag where a lead's claims are not supported by the underlying economics. Keep the screening model clean and reusable so the team can run it without you after the internship ends. Market & Pipeline Intelligence Track opportunities across ERCOT, SPP, MISO, and PJM , including interconnection queue movement and curtailment trends that create new leads. Update the pipeline tracker and executive summary so leadership has a current view of what is in the funnel and where it stands. Research specific markets, utilities, or counterparties on demand to support live deal conversations. Present a summer project to the Development & Strategy team and senior leadership — a durable improvement to how Soluna screens and qualifies opportunities. What You Bring Required Currently enrolled in an MBA program, with an expected graduation date following the internship period. Strong Excel modeling skills — comfortable building a screening model from a blank sheet, not just editing someone else's. Demonstrated analytical judgment: the ability to reach a defensible answer with incomplete information and say clearly what you do not know. Clear, concise written communication; you can compress a complicated opportunity into one page a busy executive will actually read. Genuine interest in energy, digital infrastructure, or the intersection of the two. Preferred Prior experience in energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, private equity, or corporate development. Familiarity with U.S. wholesale power markets, interconnection processes, or renewable project development. Exposure to market data platforms such as Orennia, Velocity Suite, or similar. Working knowledge of Bitcoin mining economics or AI/HPC data center demand drivers. Comfort building in PowerPoint for investor- and board-facing audiences. Why join Soluna? We are a diverse, driven team of entrepreneurs, energy experts, private equity leaders, storytellers and engineers. We are passionate about making the world greener and we have conviction about how we will bring change on a global scale. We are equally as zealous about championing our teams, relentless about developing our people, and believe strongly that Soluna’s goals and commitment to our mission are strengthened by our employee’s voices. Soluna is on a mission to solve one of renewable energy’s biggest challenges: wasted power. Our data centers convert excess solar, hydro, and wind energy into productive computational work , such as Bitcoin mining, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. By co-locating with renewable power sources, we bring demand directly to the source, helping power plants increase revenue while contributing more megawatts to the grid.

**Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About Samsara Hardware Engineering:** Samsara's hardware systems bridge the gap between the rapidly evolving world of physical operations and our cloud platform that enables our customers to increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations which power the global economy. The hardware footprint is big – we build ultra-low power sensors, ruggedized asset trackers, vehicle ADAS systems with AI/ML, telematics systems, and rackmount video inspection with AI/Ml, with more to come in the future. We leverage myriad technologies including low-power MCUs, big SoCs, DSPs, LTE, GPS, BLE, WiFi, imaging sensors, ML/AI/CV, accelerometers, and more. Our challenges span the gamut from eeking out single-digit microamps to thermals to desense to cost reduction to antenna design to enclosure design that survives extreme environments. **About the role:** We’re looking for an Electrical Engineer co-op to join our team. In the day-to-day, you will be responsible for working on the EE aspects of the design of products based on thorough feasibility, design, and cost studies encompassing key component selection, thermals, antenna, etc. We have a tremendous amount of telemetry and access to customers that help guide our design process. You will work directly with our customers to ensure we lead the industry with our product design. We run a collaborative process working closely with Product Management, PD, FW, EPM, NPI, and Hardware leadership to make excellent tradeoffs and choices. Throughout this process, you’ll share your expertise with other engineers. The US and Taiwan EE teams are supported by the Supply Chain team, laboratories, JDM design resources, and a growing supply base. You will work closely with these internal and external partners to achieve our objectives. **This role will be held at our San Francisco office. Co-ops are required to be in the office Tuesdays to Thursdays and remote work days on Mondays and Fridays. As part of the co-op program, we do provide relocation and housing support for the duration of the co-op. Please do not apply if you are unable to commit to the full duration of this co-op. We are looking for this co-op to join us from January - June 2027. At this time, we are not accepting first-year co-op students. Ideally, this student is in their junior year of school as an undergraduate student and has previous internship and/or co-op experience.** **You should apply if:** - **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. - **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Following award, Fellows may serve as consultants, analysts, specialists, researchers, trainers, facilitators, technical writers, program-support professionals, subject-matter experts, or client-facing delivery team members. The role is designed for self-directed professionals who consistently produce high-quality work, communicate reliably, collaborate effectively, and demonstrate the potential to assume broader pursuit, technical, client-facing, project-management, or leadership responsibilities over time. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Fellows may perform some or all of the following responsibilities depending on professional background, expertise, availability, client requirements, and engagement-specific needs. Opportunity Identification and Research Research clients, industries, programs, markets, procurement activity, competitors, and emerging requirements. Identify potential consulting opportunities, client needs, program initiatives, market signals, and relevant procurement activity. Support opportunity qualification by collecting and analyzing background information. Contribute market insight, technical expertise, client familiarity, or professional perspective to business-development discussions. Support development of account, market, and opportunity research. Capture and Proposal Support Support capture planning and proposal-development activities. Contribute research, technical content, management content, resumes, past-performance information, and supporting documentation. Assist with development of technical narratives, management approaches, staffing plans, presentation materials, and other proposal components. Participate in proposal reviews and quality checks. Support opportunity tracking, issue tracking, compliance checks, and documentation. Contribute specialist insight to strengthen positioning and solution development. Help identify qualified personnel, partners, or supporting resources for pursuits. Support oral presentations, demonstrations, client meetings, and related pursuit activities where appropriate. Support clients in understanding operational, technical, organizational, regulatory, process, workforce, technology, or management issues. Develop practical findings, recommendations, reports, presentations, and support documentation. Apply client methods, standards, procedures, tools, and systems as required. Maintain appropriate documentation supporting assumptions, conclusions, decisions, and deliverables. Translate complex technical or business information into clear, concise, professional content. Support editing, quality review, formatting, document control, and production activities. Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients. ### **The Role** You’ll work hands-on with innovative technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers, implementing our products to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you’ll learn our industry-leading cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies operate. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other. Start Date: July 2027 ### The Program As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will: - **Ramp up quickly.** Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration todevelop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away. - **Learn by doing.** You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve problems within your first three months. - **Thrive together.** Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback. - **Build your future.** Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you’ll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team. ### What You'll Do As part of our Professional Services team, you are a strategic partner guiding customers through implementation. We will teach you how our software works, and you will use that knowledge to design, configure, and deliver solutions that drive real business value. Your day-to-day will involve: - **Designing & tailoring the software:** You will lead the configuration of our platform to fit each customer's unique business model—setting up workflows, structuring data, and aligning system capabilities to requirements. - **Conducting discovery workshops:** You will lead interactive discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to gather business requirements, map out existing workflows, and translate their vision into actionable technical specifications for deployment. - **Managing project scope & execution:** You will take ownership of core implementation deliverables by scoping requirements, building timeline estimates, and keeping project milestones on track from kick-off through go-live. - **Guiding the customer as an expert:** You will lead the customer with best practices to ensure their business processes are optimized for maximum long-term value on our products. ### What We Are Looking For | We are open to graduates of a variety of backgrounds and look for a specific mindset: - **Drive:** You thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning. - **Curiosity:** You have a genuine desire to be hands-on with software and master new technologies. - **Communication:** You are fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills. - **Analytical Mindset:** You are a strong critical thinker with a proven track record of academic performance (in *any* degree/field of study). - **Integrity:** Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company and we expect that from all employees. - **Work Ethic:** A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results. - **Travel:** Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20-30% of the time). - **Experience**: Recent bachelor’s or master’s degree graduate (up to 2 years postgraduate experience maximum) ### How We Hire | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps: - **Apply:** Submit your resume, a short cover letter, and take a quick personality test. - **Fast Response:** We will notify you of your next step typically within one week. - **Interview & Case:** Interview with a Veeva leader. If successful, we will give you a real-world scenario (with 3 days to prepare) to present to our team. - **Offer:** We make decisions quickly—usually within a week of your final presentation. ### Perks & Benefits - Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance - Flexible PTO and company paid holidays - Retirement programs - 1% charitable giving program ### Compensation - Starting Salary: $80,000 USD - Perform well, and in one year you’ll receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program.

### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. ### **About the Maps Team** Zipline builds and operates autonomous delivery systems that enable fast, reliable, and sustainable delivery for businesses and consumers, transforming how goods move in everyday commerce. To power this, the Maps Team is building out the long term scalable solutions that enable us to fly in new countries and regions as rapidly as possible. This team is responsible for building tools and services that produce artifacts used by our vehicles to fly their missions in the real world. This means the outputs from the Maps Team define the places our vehicles will fly in the world, their constraints, and provide strong priors for the real-time system on the vehicle to follow to accomplish its mission safely. ### **The Role** In this role you will contribute to, build, and own portions of Zipline’s Maps stack. That includes contributing to an extensible path planning service used for generating routes that are operationally flown every day. It also includes a suite of services for data generation, transformation and access for path planning and flight data analytics. Your work within the team could range from path planning algorithms, validation of artifacts for compliance with flight requirements, to spatial data generation and data transformation pipelines. Your work will help us achieve multi-objective routing and efficient spatial data ingestion and access, enabling Zipline to serve more customers around the world. From this internship, you can expect to learn about how theoretical path planning algorithms are adapted for a real world problem, and how data and spatial search interact to enable routing in air. Our ideal candidate works well in startup environments, is comfortable wearing many hats, and is excited to learn about many aspects of how Zipline’s spatial planning works today. ### **What You'll Do** - Work on services that generate routes and spatial planning artifacts - Use tools to visualize and evaluate geospatial features that impact serviceability - Work with teams to make spatial data accessible instantaneously anywhere in the world - Improve planning algorithms to make routing fast, safe, and reliable ### Examples of Previous Internship Projects - Prototyping a new path planning algorithm to enhance long-range routes - Incorporating a multidimensional risk data into the routing engine - Creating tooling for generating composite Digital Elevation Models - Building infrastructure to enable our zips to survey large areas ### **What You'll Bring** - Must have at least completed the second year of your Undergraduate studies. Masters and PhD students are also eligible - Strong analytical and technical problem solving skills - Deep understanding of algorithmic optimization - Proficient coding and programming skills - Understanding of automated testing practices - Preferred experience supporting or developing novel algorithmic research - Preferred experience with spatial data ### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from (May/June - August/September).* *The hourly rate for this internship is $54 per hour. Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements.* Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. description: **About Xaira Therapeutics** Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. During your internship, you will contribute to advancing state-of-the-art machine learning models for biology, with a focus on impacting protein/antibody design and drug discovery. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with interdisciplinary experts in biology, drug discovery, and clinical research. **Responsibilities** - Develop and apply deep learning methods for protein/antibody structure, sequence, or property modeling, under the guidance and mentorship of experienced scientists and engineers - Implement and train models on GPUs using PyTorch - Contribute to ongoing research projects involving protein structure, sequence, or biophysical/affinity datasets - Participate in discussions to help generate innovative ideas for advancing AI methodologies in computational protein design - Document findings and communicate progress effectively to peers and mentors **Qualifications** - Currently pursuing a MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, with strong publication record - Hands-on experience with PyTorch and training/inference of AI models on GPUs - Strong interest in AI innovation and its applications to interdisciplinary fields such as biology and chemistry - Extensive hands-on experience with deep learning methods and frameworks - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and learn from experienced mentors - A scientifically curious mindset with a passion for exploring new challenges - Experience with large-scale distributed training and inference is a plus - Exposure to molecular structure or biological sequence data or computational biology/bioinformatics is a plus, but not required - Prior research experience demonstrated through publications and/or significant open source code authorship - Interest in contributing to open-source deep learning libraries and frameworks is a plus **Internship Duration**3 months *The expected monthly compensation range is $10,000–$15,000, depending on experience and qualifications. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. ### **About the Maps Team** Zipline builds and operates autonomous delivery systems that enable fast, reliable, and sustainable delivery for businesses and consumers, transforming how goods move in everyday commerce. To power this, the Maps Team is building out the long term scalable solutions that enable us to fly in new countries and regions as rapidly as possible. This team is responsible for building tools and services that produce artifacts used by our vehicles to fly their missions in the real world. This means the outputs from the Maps Team define the places our vehicles will fly in the world, their constraints, and provide strong priors for the real-time system on the vehicle to follow to accomplish its mission safely. ### **The Role** In this role you will contribute to, build, and own portions of Zipline’s Maps stack. That includes contributing to an extensible path planning service used for generating routes that are operationally flown every day. It also includes a suite of services for data generation, transformation and access for path planning and flight data analytics. Your work within the team could range from path planning algorithms, validation of artifacts for compliance with flight requirements, to spatial data generation and data transformation pipelines. Your work will help us achieve multi-objective routing and efficient spatial data ingestion and access, enabling Zipline to serve more customers around the world. From this internship, you can expect to learn about how theoretical path planning algorithms are adapted for a real world problem, and how data and spatial search interact to enable routing in air. Our ideal candidate works well in startup environments, is comfortable wearing many hats, and is excited to learn about many aspects of how Zipline’s spatial planning works today. ### **What You'll Do** - Work on services that generate routes and spatial planning artifacts - Use tools to visualize and evaluate geospatial features that impact serviceability - Work with teams to make spatial data accessible instantaneously anywhere in the world - Improve planning algorithms to make routing fast, safe, and reliable ### Examples of Previous Internship Projects - Prototyping a new path planning algorithm to enhance long-range routes - Incorporating a multidimensional risk data into the routing engine - Creating tooling for generating composite Digital Elevation Models - Building infrastructure to enable our zips to survey large areas ### **What You'll Bring** - Must have at least completed the second year of your Undergraduate studies. Masters and PhD students are also eligible - Strong analytical and technical problem solving skills - Deep understanding of algorithmic optimization - Proficient coding and programming skills - Understanding of automated testing practices - Preferred experience supporting or developing novel algorithmic research - Preferred experience with spatial data ### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Spring 2027 interns from (January 2027 - April 2027).* *The hourly rate for this internship is $54 per hour. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process. ### **Voluntary Self-Identification** For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike. **Tecovas** is looking for a Junior Designer, Men’s Footwear to support the Product Design team in creating innovative, brand-right footwear. Reporting directly to the Design Director, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn seasonal direction, market insights, and trend research into commercial product concepts that reflect the Tecovas brand. This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX. **What you’ll do:** - Support the design team in translating seasonal direction and trend research into fresh, globally relevant concepts. - Assist in developing upper designs, outsoles, trims, and embellishments that align with Tecovas’ aesthetic. - Create detailed illustrations, CADs, and tech packs using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product design aligns with pricing, timelines, and brand goals. - Help manage design projects from concept to final execution while meeting deadlines. - Participate in prototype reviews and help update tech packs based on feedback. - Maintain and contribute to a digital asset library with swatches, components, templates, and more. - Organize inspiration, samples, and prototypes to support the design process. - Travel internationally and attend tradeshows and events as needed. **Experience we’re looking for:** - Bachelor’s degree in Footwear Design, Fashion Design, or Industrial Design, or equivalent experience. - 1-3 years of relevant experience in footwear design preferred, but not required. - Proficiency in creating CADs, tech packs, and technical drawings - Familiarity with 3D design software a plus - Bonus points for experience in leather goods and an understanding of Western lifestyle or culture **What you bring to the table:** - You are passionate about product design and craftsmanship - especially leather and footwear. - You are detail oriented, organized, and driven to meet deadlines. - You can manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work on time. - You have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly present your ideas. **Full Time Benefits & Perks:** - We offer insurance plans that pay 79-90% of your health premium coverage and 100% of your dental & vision insurance coverage for your family/dependents - Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. As an engineering intern, you'd play a critical role in lots of our projects. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. **Who You Are** - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field AND are willing to take off a semester to work full time in SF. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

role: Streets Services - Street Maintenance Technician Trainee, I, II, III, IV
description: GENERAL DESCRIPTION Under immediate supervision, to perform skilled work in the construction and maintenance of street and alley systems to include, earth work preparation in the right-of-way, construction of rigid (portland concrete), flexible (asphaltic) base, and gravel surfaces as well as the operation and preventive maintenance care of heavy construction, maintenance equipment, and machinery. SUPERVISION EXERCISED The Street Maintenance Technician (SMT) Trainee, I, II, and III exercise no supervision. The Street Maintenance Technician (SMT) IV may exercise technical and functional supervision over lower-level staff. IMPORTANT AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES Street Maintenance Technician Trainee, I, II, III, IV Operate dump trucks that have the capacity to haul up to 18 tons of materials. Perform minor maintenance and servicing on equipment operated. Perform manual work as required. May operate mechanical sweeper. Operate various compaction rollers up to 10 tons. Pull various utility trailers with pickup and dump trucks. Street Maintenance Technician II, III, IV Operate 2,000-gallon water trucks, including earth moving equipment. Operate vibratory steel wheel and pneumatic rollers for compaction of natural soils or chemically prepared soils in the sub-grade or base. Operate mechanical sweepe and skid steer loader. May operate rubber tire loader and stabilizer/recycler. Street Maintenance Technician III, IV Operate a self-propelled loader in excess of three-yard capacity. Operate a 2,000-gallon liquid asphalt distributor. Operate a backhoe of less than 14 feet extension. Operate black-top paving machine to specified depth. Perform minor servicing to assigned equipment; report mechanical or other problems. Compact hot mix asphalt with steel wheel or pneumatic roller during the finishing phase. Stockpile base in confined spaces for use in construction projects. Operate Bomag reclaimer. Street Maintenance Technician IV Operate a motor grader with blade, scarifier, and other attachments in the maintenance and repair of gravel streets, alleys, and roads; blade streets, alleys, roads, shoulders, and flood control areas to obtain proper grade, crown, and slope. Process base for asphalt and rigid paving in confined areas. As required, operate a 10-ton truck tractor to haul heavy equipment to various sites. Set metal and wooden forms, place reinforcing steel and various preparation work for the placement of concrete. Level concrete to a specified depth and workable consistency with the use of a wooden, aluminum, or powered screed. Remove rough or defective spots from concrete and/or flexible surfaces OTHER JOB RELATED DUTIES Patch potholes with the use of a roller and utility trailers. Place traffic control devices as directed on construction projects. Perform other job related duties and responsibilities as assigned. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES Street Maintenance Technician Trainee, I Knowledge of: Operation of large construction trucks and smaller construction equipment such as drills, jack hammers, and concrete saws. Operating characteristics and servicing of one or more types of medium automotive and related equipment. Work hazards and applicable safety precautions associated with assigned equipment and operations. Applicable traffic laws, ordinances, and regulations involved in the operation of assigned equipment. Safe driving principles and practices. Skill to: Operate and care for a variety of tools, machinery, and equipment used in work assigned. Safely operate a motor vehicle and other equipment. Ability to: Locate, understand, and find information in Materials Safety Data Sheets Perform minor equipment maintenance and repairs. Understand and follow oral written instructions and communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. Make minor operating adjustments and recognize operating deficiencies in assigned equipment. Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work, both internally and externally. Follow and embrace the City of Abilene Core Values – Respect, Integrity, Service Above Self, and Excellence in All We Do. Perform as a team member in a manner that accomplishes the Division’s mission and treats team members with dignity, courtesy, and respect. Street Maintenance Technician II Knowledge of: Texas Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (TMUTCD). Street Maintenance Technician III Knowledge of: On-Call and emergency policies and procedures. Operating characteristics of heavy equipment in maintenance and construction projects. Heavy construction techniques. Flexible and rigid pavements. Skill to: Operate a variety of heavy equipment including 2,000 gallon asphalt distributor, rubber tired loader, hot mix lay down machine, backhoe loader, and chip spreader. description: About This Unit Beds: 33-bed General Medical Surgical Unit Patient Population: D37 cares for adult patients with a wide range of medical conditions. Typical Cases: Our patients often have chronic illnesses that are experiencing acute exacerbation, as well as newly diagnosed conditions that require treatment and ongoing management. While addressing acute health concerns, we also focus on managing each patient's chronic conditions to promote overall health and recovery. Additional Info: D37 offers nurses the opportunity to develop and maintain a broad range of clinical skills while caring for a diverse patient population. Nurses on the unit gain hands-on experience with advanced procedures and technologies, including IV insertion and management, urinary catheterization insertion and management, Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD), blood product administration, chest tube management, central line care and, enteral feeding tubes, telemetry monitoring, restraints, rectal tube management, and enemas. Located in the heart of Central Virginia, Centra Health is a regional, nonprofit healthcare system comprised of hospitals, medical centers, and a network of specialty and primary care practices throughout the Blue Ridge region. Centra has earned its fifth Magnet® designation, a prestigious recognition that reflects our ongoing commitment to nursing excellence, professional development, and exceptional patient care. The Clinical Registered Nurse (RN) I is the entry level for new graduate nurses who are still in or finishing their new graduate orientation. This RN is responsible for managing individualized patient care by promoting and restoring patients' health in accordance with medical and nursing plans of care and established policies and procedures. The Clinical RN I collaborates with physicians and multidisciplinary team members in the development, execution, and evaluation of the multidisciplinary plan of care. The Clinical Registered Nurse I provides nursing services to patients and families in accordance with the scope of the RN as defined by the Virginia Board of Nursing. This RN maintains a safe care environment for their patients (clients) and delivers quality care. Job Responsibilities Assessment Conducts an individualized patient assessment, prioritizing the data collection based on the patient’s immediate condition or needs within timeframe specified by policies, procedures, or protocols. Conducts ongoing assessments as determined by patient’s condition and/or the policies, procedures or protocols and reprioritizes care accordingly. Integrates nursing interventions into the multidisciplinary plan of care, incorporating appropriate standards of care and practice and patient outcomes. Planning Develops, modifies, and integrates an individualized care plan which incorporates the medical plan of care, key elements from the plans of other disciplines, and standards of care and practice. Establishes individualized, measurable patient goals in consultation with the patient, family, and health care team. Intervention Performs appropriate treatments as ordered by provider in an accurate and timely manner. Performs therapeutic nursing interventions as established by individualized plan of care for the patient and his/her family. Recognizes potential problems and responds to general information/data indicating urgent and/or emergent risk to the patient. Initiates emergency resuscitative measures as appropriate. Assumes responsibility and accountability for effectively managing the care of a specialty patient population. Provides care in a non-judgmental, non-discriminatory manner that is culturally sensitive to the patient and family, preserving their autonomy, dignity, and rights. Collaborates with interdisciplinary team members to ensure patient care interventions are appropriate. Evaluation Evaluates patient’s responses to care based on effectiveness of nursing interventions/actions in relationship to established goals. Initiates changes in the interdisciplinary care plan based on this evaluation. Problem solves with the specialty team to improve patient outcomes. Documents patient assessment findings, physical/psychosocial responses to nursing intervention and progress towards problem resolution. Patient Education Identifies learning needs of patients/families and teaches by adapting standard information based on needs. Ensures that the patient/family demonstrates knowledge, within the abilities of the patient. Communicates with patients and family to identify their needs and include them in the plan of care. Acknowledges and supports determinations by the patient and/or family concerning treatment. Self and Peer Learning Assumes responsibility for assessing and meeting own learning and professional development needs. Maintains current competency in nursing specialty and requirements for department; attends required educational programs and may attend additional educational workshops; reviews nursing professional publications; establishes personal networks; may participate in professional societies. Collaboration Makes sound judgments in the decisions involved in coordinating multiple, increasingly complex patient care demands. Supervises delegated care based on abilities of personnel and patient acuity. Reports changes in patient condition to appropriate personnel. Service Recovery Participates in service recovery and uses appropriate resources during complex situations. Handles conflict resolution in an appropriate, timely and consistent manner. Resource Utilization and Stewardship Supports organizational efforts regarding appropriate resource utilization (i.e. flexing during low census). May begin training for a charge nurse role or as a preceptor if has strong leadership aptitude. Improvement Activities Participates in data collection for quality assurance activities if assigned by department leader. Identifies and communicates recurring practice concerns in specialty areas and their impact on care. Participates in initiatives resulting from nurse-sensitive, quality, and other specialty indicators and/or unit-based quality metrics. Demonstrates the utilization of Centra’s safety behaviors (i.e. Speak Up for Safety). Research/Evidence Based Practice/Quality Improvement Projects May participate in Research or Evidence Based Practice projects. At an entry level with ability to to communicate research and quality improvement data/findings to peers. At an entry level with ability to be able to interpret quality improvement data relevant to the clinical specialty and communicate this data to peers. At an entry level with ability to contribute s to the development or implementation of methods to improve quality care in areas identified as deficient by quality improvement data studies. Ethics Maintains confidentiality in matters as outlined in Centra policies. Delivers care in a manner that protects patient autonomy, dignity, and rights. Serves as a patient advocate. Maintains patient-nurse relationships with professional role boundaries. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Required Education: Diploma or Associate Degree in Nursing Required Experience / Skills: New Graduate up to six months of RN experience. Required Certifications and Licensures: Registration as a registered nurse in the Commonwealth of Virginia and/or holds a compact license to practice in Virginia. AHA BLS Provider Additional Specialty Requirements – Advanced Cardiac Life Support Cath Lab/Electrophysiology Operating Room Critical Care (All) Endoscopy PACU Interventional Radiology Birth Center Centra Specialty Hospital Outpatient Ambulatory Surgery Plastic Surgery Registered Nurse Outpatient Ambulatory Surgery Additional Specialty Requirements – Pediatric Advanced Life Support Pediatrics Additional Specialty Requirements – Advanced and Pediatric Advanced Life Support Emergency Dept. Salary Range: $31.05 - $48.13/Hour
